reviews.text: The food was really good. My issues were just with the service. People work a table together, but seem scattered and disorganized on what they are doing. Also, if you order an expensive Branzino at a 5 star resort, they usually debone and filet that kind of fish in front of you. Other than that, we enjoyed it.

Absolutely fantastic!!! Beautiful environment. Professional and personable staff. Food was excellent. Highly recommend the shrimp and grits (with or without the tasso gravy) AND the shareable cinnamon bun is a must.

The food was questionable and somewhat edible. They try to stick us out on the patio, which was 101° that was not acceptable. They stuck us in a banquet room at a long rectangular table which was not conducive to then another large group came in, and they were extremely obnoxious and kept shouting and carrying on so that wasn’t cool. I don’t know. I got married at that property 20 years ago and I used to have class now it’s just rubbish so good luck to them. I won’t be back.

Always a great experience at M + C; My eggs Benedict was prepared perfectly and my Bloody Mary was at the perfect spice level. Ernesto is an all star server and goes above and beyond for his guests. Thank you can’t wait to return!
Beautiful ambience , exceptional service  and excellent food !

We had a great dinner in a beautiful location .  Service was excellent and very attentive to  children’s menu needs for our three year old. Hangar steak was exceptional as was the Lemon tart we had for dessert.  Top notch

Our server Gloria was over the top AMAZING! it was literally like being served by an old friend !
And the food was amazing as well
Overall wonderful experience. Food was excellent. Prices were fair.
Great and convenient service. We got light apps and a salad and all were amazing!
Server, Quinn, was fantastic. Food and experience were all great.

We went for breakfast/ brunch on a sunday and didn't realize that they only had a brunch menu.
the server contacted the chef an we were able to make substitutions and order the breakfast we wanted.  We were very pleased with the service and had a great breakfast
I went for dinner.  Very good food. Prices a bit high.  I would recommend it.
Seated next to families with fussy children. Service was good, but food was underwhelming.
The dishes can be overcomplicated with muddled tastes. The shishito pepper dish is an apt example.

Our server was wonderful and the staff went over and above to make our experience a great one. The hostess even searched for mosquito repellant for us so my son wouldn't get bitten while we sat outside.
Great dining  experience for 8 of us at Mowry and Cotton.  Food, service, and ambiance was more than wonderful.  We will be back!
Food was excellent. Service was wonderful. Servers were very nice. The sea bass was to die for.
We thoroughly enjoyed our experience. Food was great, especially the giant cinnamon roll. Service was great. Sitting outside on a beautiful day was wonderful.
Beautiful spot and the service was top notch.  Food was okay, but not as good as expected based on other reviews.
The Phoenician is amazing!  From the moment you walk in they treat you like King & Queen.
Very good experience with good food. Would definitely go back.

The waiter was out of Saturday night live
The most obnoxious, self imposed waiter ever
Great restaurant, awesome atmosphere, wonderful food. Great service.
Great service. The food was delicious. The site is beautiful. Our out of town friends really enjoyed it.

We had the best experience of our trip with Dora. She was very attentive and was one of the best servers we have ever had. She made the experience at Mowry & Cotton A+. Food was amazing as well as the atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Mowry & Cotton at the Phoenician Resort was absolutely delicious in every possible way. From the moment we were seated, the experience felt thoughtful, elevated, and welcoming. Every dish was beautifully prepared, bursting with flavor, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients and real care.

The food struck that perfect balance between refined and comforting—creative without being pretentious. Each bite felt intentional, fresh, and satisfying, making it one of those meals you keep thinking about long after it’s over.

The service matched the food: attentive, warm, and professional without ever feeling rushed. The ambiance tied it all together—stylish, relaxed, and exactly what you’d hope for at a resort of this caliber.

Mowry & Cotton isn’t just a meal; it’s an experience. Truly outstanding, and a must-visit when staying at (or visiting) the Phoenician. We’ll absolutely be back. 🍽️✨
Amazing place to eat, you have to ask for tables with Sunshine, she was great at her job, attentive to detail and overall made the experience so much better.

Gloria was of amazing service and provided great suggestions. Everything we ordered tasted great. Nicholas Karnezis met us upon arrival and welcomed my mother and I into the Phoenician resort exceptionally well and guided us all the way to our dining area for the evening! 10/10 Overall amazing experience :)

The menu was a little different and not what
We were thinking but we enjoyed our eve.

Delicious food and excellent service. Lots of dietary restrictions which they accommodated with a smile. Shelly is an attentive server. Really enjoyed ourselves for breakfast, lunch and especially New Years Eve. Phenomenal Chilean Seabass.

For me, most of the food was over-salted and
￼over-seasoned, which made it inedible… yet with each full plate the server cleared away (eventually…) I was never asked if there was something wrong with the full plate of food that I did not eat. I also never saw any of the charcuterie platters that were supposed to be out during the concert section of the night. ￼I said nothing in the moment because my point was to enjoy NYE with my friends, which I did… but as for food and service, both were highly lacking in quality￼, and ￼you definitely did not make it onto my list of go-to restaurants!! Overall, I was highly disappointed by my experience at your establishment!
Great Christmas Day dinner at M&C. We come here a few times a year and never disappoints.

This was a very special evening. The setting is stunning, our server was superb, very familiar with the menu and pointing out special ingredients. Our party of four ended up selecting only dishes to be shared and every item was a pleasing surprise.

My family comes here every Christmas Eve as a tradition the past few years. The food is out of this world. My dad said our meal was the best meal he’s ever had.

Our server was Cassandra and she was FABULOUS! She gave great recommendations and was on top of our every need.

This place is a hidden gem.
Beautiful restaurant outside with a very taste filled meal
Place was not crowded when we arrived. Staff was very friendly. Good view, outstanding food and service.
Shelly was an attentive and delightful server.  The Shakshuka was amazing and just right spicy. The location is gorgeous.

Wonderful Brunch
We celebrated my husband’s birthday with an amazing brunch. The food, service and atmosphere were outstanding. We will be back.
Service, atmosphere great but food was little disappointing.  Chicken presentation was better than chicken itself.  Expect chicken to fall off bone so difficult to cut and eat.
We had Brunch. Amazing as always. Cassandra was our server. Knowledgeable and professional. Monkey bread is to die for....
Fell short of Marriott's usual standards. Overpriced for food received.
Lovely place,  good food, drinks and service.  Hard to find the parking and the restaurant itself.   A bit pricey.
Our dinner was amazing. All of the food was delicious and our waiter Quinn provided impeccable service. The lamb pappardelle was the best pasta we’ve had in a very long time.
meal was over cooked.ask for steaks to be medium they arrived well done.
The service was excellent - the food to die for. It was quiet and. The ambience was excellent .
Always a great experience! Creative menu. Can’t wait to return.

I wanted to celebrate my son's engagement by taking the couple to an upscale lunch.  This was not it.  From seating to serving, the service was inadequate, and each part took forever.  The hostess had a difficult time finding a table although only one was occupied.  The server took a long time to come to the table.  When she did, she was nice, but the drinks and food took forever to be served.  The food was adequate, but not worthy of its price. All in all, I was very disappointed that I arranged this celebratory lunch at what I thought was a very nice restaurant only to have a high bill, adequate but slow service, and food I could have gotten for a lot less elsewhere.  One good thing is I requested a special dessert for the engagement, and that turned out well--and it was delivered by the only good employee we met all day; a young man who was attentive, focused, efficient , and aware.  We also did have a good laugh at how poor everything was considering the location and resputaion of the Phoenician.

Hi-

Our experience last evening at Mowry and Cotton was perfect!

The hosts at the front desk were very attentive and p[ersonable and our server, Patrick, was beyond notable.

My partner had the Hangar steak and asked for it to be cooked medium rare-rare and her sister also had the Hangar steak, asking for it to be cooked medium.

Both steaks were perfectly cooked to their requests and my Halibut was delicious, as were the Yukon mashed potatoes . . .  Kinda hard to mess up mashed potatoes :-)!!!

The manager actually stopped by at the end of our dinner to make sure all was well and I assured her it was.

Thanks again for such a great and unique spot with the best Red Sangria in town :-)!!!

Best,

Bud McLarty
Very nice ambiance, good service and great food. Perfect location for a quiet lunch with family.
Everything was perfect: View, Food, Ambiance and Service. Went back twice for lunch!

First impression, lovely greeting table. Was taken to our choice of table, but noted that many tables still had dirty dishes on them and blackbirds were literally standing on the table eating the remains.   we were seated and our drinks were eventually brought to us. However, they were out of two entrées for some reason. It then took over 45 minutes to get our food. There were only five tables occupied outdoors. Clearly they do not have enough waiter help. We looked at those tables of dirty dishes for quite a while that I described above…. Including our own table that was not cleared in a timely manner. Just a wholly disappointing experience.
Food is good. It is an ok option if you are staying in the resort, otherwise not worth the trip.
Great service and atmosphere!! Pricing was high but to be expected at a resort.

Mowry & Cotton is the best place to have an early dinner. Our server always comes with a smile and explains all the outstanding entrees. There was even an entertainment celebrating Labor Day weekend. Best place to dine!
We enjoyed a glass of wine and an appetizer while waiting to have afternoon tea upstairs.  The falcon and falconer on patio was intriguing.
Waiter was awesome; the meal was great, however the cocktail was outrageous and will prevent a return visit.
Great service.
Fairly restricted menu, sweetcorn soup was very good, I had the chicken which was too large and difficult to eat. However our server was excellent and good fun
Al was an amazing server. Great experience. The food was unbelievably delicious.
We had the sausage flatbread, lobster gnocchi and steak which had blueberries. It was amazing
The food was amazing, our waiter Hector very knowledgeable and wonderful, suggestions on spot! Ambience was also very good! We will come back again:))
Amazing food! Service was wonderful, we had probably 5-6 diff people come around and make sure we were good.
Server AL was awesome! He’s been there for 30 years and it shows with his outgoing personality and attention to detail. Definitely I will return and ask for him !￼

The food was absolutely perfect. The view, however, is not. We were expecting a much better view, but from this restaurant you aren’t able to see Camelback or the luxurious pools. You can only see the “recreational pool.” So, expect to see people swimming and hanging. This was still an incredible experience though. We loved their summer special fixed menu and felt it was a great value. Overall, we recommend! But don’t expect the incredible views you might think you’re getting at a 5 star resort.

As soon as we walked through the doors, it was nothing short of best-in-class service.  Our server, Christine, truly exhibit world class care and she is a true professional with a wonderful, positive personality.  Mowry and Cotton should be proud to have her as an amazing team member.  Food was excellent.  A cozy and chill resort friendly atmosphere.
Excellent food would recommend but service was just average.

Ms. Christine was out server and was outstanding. She made sure if there were any allergies and provided an amazing experience for our niece and great niece with it being their 1st time at Mowry & Cotton.   Thank you, Ms Christine.

Slow and inefficient service.  Water glasses are size of rocks glass and we had to ask for refills since they set empty almost whole meal.
Rolls appetizer is not worth it.  They came out not even room temperature...should be served warm like most quality restaurants do with this type of bread.
Not even as good as most restaurants free bread.
The rest of our meal was very average.  Ribeye had an odd seasoning.

What an amazing experience! From checking in at the front desk to our table everyone we dealt with was incredibly friendly. Ernesto was our server and was phenomenal. He gave us good insight into the menu as well as tips for exploring the beautiful property. I made a reservation outside and was a bit nervous about it for a late May lunch reservation.  We are Arizona residents and found the patio to be so pleasant, it was fully shaded and had misters and you wouldn’t know it was almost 100 out! Every single food item tasted fresh and the flavors were to die for. An incredible experience overall.

The hanger steak tasted good, but came lukewarm as did the grilled shrimp was tasty but undercooked and also lukewarm. ￼

It was very noisy as the restaurant is in a Hotel and there were children activities going on. If I had known it was part of the hotel I wouldn’t have went. ￼

Upon arrival there is valet  parking for around $30 or you can self park and walk to find your restaurant ￼￼
Great service and perfect for kids! Very accommodating

Great food, good service. Appreciated the crayons and coloring pages as well as the high chair all set up for my daughter when we got to our table. Was also really nice to get the toddlers food with our drinks, super accommodating for small kids. I am personally not a fan of birds, so didn’t really enjoy the hawk flying right over our heads during brunch.  I understand that it’s helpful to keep the smaller birds away but just kind of gross. My daughter really loved watching it though.
Great food & service! Love the views from the Phoenician.

Amazing service (Hector was awesome) and flavorful food. Portions were very good sized and good value for the price. Don't miss the appetizers! It was very quiet for a Friday night and we had a great time. Extensive drink menu.  If you are in the area well worth a visit.
Our bartender made this bday celebration for my girlfriend and day to remember
We all had the salmon and it was tasty. Definitely recommend this place to friends n

We celebrated my Mom’s 86th Birthday on the patio, and it was heavenly. Their asparagus soup and signature buns with butter were outstanding. A fabulous dining experience that was relaxing and celebratory!
Beautiful view and delicious food. The service was exceptional and the atmosphere was great.

Our waiter Chris was very attentive. Restaurant was what I'd call upscale pool restaurant. Prices typical for resorts in general. Food was very good and above the typical fare. Very satisfying portions.

Ordered my steak rare, but it came out medium well. My friend's salmon was also over cooked. Our server was friendly and eager to please, but poorly trained. We were a party of six in active conversation, but he kept inserting himself into our conversation by peppering us with questions. At 9:22, the lights in the restaurant turned to bright. I looked around and saw that we were the only guests remaining. It seemed like they had turned up the lights to get us to leave. I was livid and expressed my displeasure to our server. The lights were turned down. The manager appeared to apologize and explain that there was a timer that automatically turned the lights up. Huh?! So every night at 9:22 the lights turn bright? I didn't believe him and made that clear to him. He seemed annoyed with me. I spent $1400 and this is the Phoenician, but it felt like Applebee's quality. I dine out a lot, but I won't be back to Mowry and Cotton. Go to Tarbell's instead.

Staff was great, super nice and sat us early! Food was good, abit dry but plated very nicely. The lighting is beautiful and was pretty quiet and a pleasant experience. Will definitely be back if we stay at the Phoenician again!
Enjoyed our brunch, but the birds were relentless even with the hawk. Service was good, albeit a little slow for an emptier time at the restaurant. Overall, good.

We stayed at the resort. Had birthday reservations and requested to sit inside. When they sat us they tried to sit us outside and we mentioned we wanted to be inside. Our reservation was at 7. They had already cleaned inside and didn’t want to dirty a table but they accommodated us nonetheless. Wish they wouldn’t have. They ignored us, sat us by a loud cash register and talked behind us about personal issues. They also opened to the doors to be cute. As if to say, you’re technically inside. Is a person no longer allowed to request a table if it’s hot outside? So disappointed and underwhelmed. Not much to choose for a pescatarian either. Not impressed for the amount we spent and didn’t appreciate feeling unwelcome by the staff.

Relaxed, pretty restaurant with nice al fresco seating —best for ambiance.  Food was not bad but a little slow coming out of the kitchen.  Servers were friendly but forgot some of our courses—and removed these items from our bill without question at the end of the meal when they realized the courses never came.  Pretty ambiance overlooking pool and nice nearby green lawns for kids to mingle and play with other kids.  Cocktails could be better put together for those who love cocktails but otherwise an Easy evening!

Dirty tables everywhere servers leaving for next shift.

Cheap patio furniture

Food was good

No placemats

Expensive
Was just okay.  Don’t bring your kids if they are picky eaters.  Cowboy ribeye was good.  The choices for sides wasn’t great.  Overall, not worth the high price.
Beautiful outdoor seating with shade. Loved the Hawk!  The food and service were excellent!
Great ambiance.  Server was most professional.  Great kids men.
Jordan is the best server. Great ambassador for the brand!
Great meal with excellent service and wonderful food

Our server Kathryn was equal parts knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the menu. She may have been one of the best servers I've ever had. And her enthusiasm for the food was not misguided. Everything we had was incredible. If you're in Scottsdale you must visit the Phoenician for an incredible dining experience at Mowry & Cotton.
Wonderful time on the patio. Love the falconer with his hawk!! Fresh food presented well. Good service. Free valet. Nice time!

Horrible experience.  Waited 45 minutes for a cocktail.  Dinner was another 30 minute wait.  Food arrived lukewarm.  We told the waiter and we were offered a complimentary dessert which we declined.  Who knows how long that wait might be.  An expensive and totally forgettable meal.  Don’t go
Great food and service — enjoyed the steak and potatoes
Lovely atmosphere and good food.  Exceptional service. Would recommend definitely.

We have been going to Mowry & Cotton for many years. It’s our go to place for special occasions. We enjoy the ambience and the service. We are always greeted and made to feel welcome. When it comes to the food, the taste and texture is amazing. The food is delicious and an art form. You can tell how much thought and effort is given by the chef. It’s is truly a wonderful dining experience every time. The drinks are also thoughtfully paired with your meal to make it even a better experience. Enjoy!
The Buns and Soup were amazing. Had meatballs and a filet. Everything was a 10. Hector was fantastic and helped with wine pairings!  Can’t wait to go back.
Great martini!  Great pizza!
Menu looks intriguing but the food itself is less so.
We had a great experience and our server was very in tune to our needs.  The food was unique and delicious!
Excellent food and service. Our waiter was Jordan, I highly recommend him. He helped us navigate the menu by offering great suggestions. Can’t wait to go back.
Beautiful environment but the food did not match up to the environment

Went for lunch
Was freezing cold
Table sticky on top
Food was cold - fries had to send back
Coleslaw tasted spoiled
Sandwiches lukewarm
Service mediocre
Prices expensive for moderate quality of food
Not high end like resort it is in. Go elsewhere.
Amazing meal. Exceptional service. Staff were friendly and awesome

The atmosphere was wonderful, in fact quiet, wasn't many people in there, which was nice so could talk and hear one another.
Food was excellent, presentation was beautiful!  
The only thing I would complain about is they didn't have warm bread to serve!  No bread, no nothing!  You need warm bread like they have for dinner, to serve for lunch menu!
Our Server, Gloria, was exceptional!  She went the extra mile when we asked for bread with our salad, she went and found some.  She was so pleasant and very attentive! 
I will going back and also telling friends and family about it!
Our server Gloria was a delight! The food was excellent. All of the waitstaff were very attentive and were quick to help out when needed (bussing a table, refilling water).
The food was absolutely phenomenal. Everything that we ordered was Perfection,  will definitely be back again.

We were greeted and seated right away when checking in.  Our waitress was super attentive and took time to review menu questions and had some really good suggestions.  The food was delicious and came out hot, that’s was a plus.  The noise level was low so that you could have a conversation with the person across and be able to hear everything they said.
Good service. Great outdoor seating. French toast was great.

If you're on the hunt for a brunch spot that feels like a culinary celebration, look no further than Mowry & Cotton at The Phoenician in Scottsdale. From the moment you step onto their sun-dappled patio, you're met with a laid-back yet refined atmosphere that pairs perfectly with their unforgettable menu. But let's talk about their burger and fries—an absolute masterpiece. The burger is cooked to perfection, with a juicy patty layered with bold flavors and melty goodness, all hugged by a toasted bun that deserves a standing ovation. And the fries? Crispy, golden, and seasoned to make your taste buds do a happy dance. This is not just a meal; it's an experience that sets the bar impossibly high for brunch indulgence.
We were not staying at the resort, but we stopped for lunch and what a pleasant surprise.  Incredible food and service was fast and friendly.    Can’t wait to go back.

We emphasized the tree nut allergy of one of our guests both online and in-person.  Our server, Cassandra, likely saved my daughter’s life when she noticed that the kitchen staff put tree nuts on my daughter’s meal.
Cassie was a wonderful server, she had great suggestions and made the experience wonderful!

First time to visit. Ordered the Chritsmas menue. We could choose but not required. That was great. The food was beyond our expectations. Beautiful restaurant and wonderful , not hurried, service.
We will return for more adventures from the chef. Lovely !

We chose to have Christmas dinner at Mowry & Cotton because they offered extensive ala carte choices in addition to an appealing fixed price menu.   Everyone enjoyed the dishes they ordered, and portions were so generous that leftovers had to be boxed and taken home.  Accessibility was a factor for the oldest member of our group, so were seated on the main level.  A ramp provided easy access to the lower level of the dining room and the outdoor patio seating.  This was our first visit to Mowry & Cotton.  We all agreed that we would return to sample non-holiday brunch, lunch and dinner options ... and we look forward to dining on the patio.
Couldn’t have been a nicer Christmas Day-Very relaxing and lovely-great food and our service was amazing!

Food is always amazing. Cocktails are perfect. Smokey Old Fashioned is a super cool presentation.
Today was Christmas and a special menu was available. Service is attentive without hovering.

We had a lovely experience at this restaurant. Our server, Gloria was fantastic. The food was incredible. We were not rushed at all and it was not too loud. Excellent Christmas Eve dinner. We will be back and it may be a new tradition.

Squash soup was fantastic. Salmon bowl very good. Beef tacos very good. Nice outdoor seating, although workers started moving portable hedges between seating area and pool area while we were eating—blocked our view.

This restaurant is amazing.  The whole experience was fantastic.  From the beginning to the end we were happy.  The restaurant is beautiful, immaculate and scenic. The food is fresh, creative and delicious.  The SERVICE was the best part. Our server, Christine, went more than above and beyond to make sure our experience was outstanding.  I may even say she was the best server experience I’ve ever had, including at Michelin rated restaurants.  Excellent restaurant!
Great food and drinks menu. Nice staff as well. A bit expensive, which should be expected for the Phoenician. Worth it, however.
Food was amazing. Our server was both knowledgeable and friendly. While the restaurant is expensive, you get what you pay for. Fantastic!!

Went for Thanksgiving dinner.  Thought the price of $80/pp for three courses was a lot.  The dinner was good, especially the butternut squash soup. Turkey, mashed potatoes, and cranberry were good, the stuffing...not so much.

My dinner service on 11/21 was excellent in terms of the staff and food quality—both were outstanding. However, my experience was completely overshadowed by a couple of intoxicated individuals at the bar who were yelling at the wait staff about their coursed meal. Their behavior disrupted the entire atmosphere. I ultimately had to request another waiter to move me to a different area because it was ruining my evening, it tarnished an otherwise wonderful evening.

We had a mind blowing experience at this restaurant. We sat at the bar. Started the evening with an outstanding bartender. We ordered appetizers, salads, dinner and sides. For some reason, the first two courses came too fast as we were not even finished our first course when they brought the other course. We let it go because they were salads with the second course. Then came the main course without the sides… 20 minutes later… the sides came but the main were already eaten. When we enquired how such a rookie mistake in service was made, the assistant manager came to apologize and comp our dinner…. However… once the dinner comp. We said thank your for understanding and fixing this poor dining experience! Well this gesture from them came with not allowing us to order anything else for the evening and requesting our room number. It was their mistake but our fault! According to the assistant manager, her staff needed more training, they are new members, and it’s by saying something about bad service that they get better. A sub par experience for a 5* luxury resort. The restaurant was not even busy that night. Better go to J & G steakhouse for outstanding service!

It was awkward at first when we arrived, but the server did everything in her power to make it right. We booked our reservation here because it was advertised as having a view but it fell short on that. The food was very good and for that we would go back. Compliments to the chef.
Had an excellent lunch out on the patio. We splint a Caesar Salad and shared the Chicken Sandwich.
Great restaurant from a service food and ambience point of view!
Great service and great food!! Can’t wait to come back

Brisket Benedict was delicious. Perfectly poached eggs.
Mushroom flatbread very flavorful.
Chocolate raspberry cake was decadent. Sat on the patio. It was a beautiful day.

I recently revisited Mowry & Cotton after having a great experience there for brunch a few years ago. Unfortunately, this time around, it was a disappointing visit that didn’t live up to my prior expectations.

The most noticeable difference was in the food quality, which seemed to have dropped significantly while the prices have surged. For three people, we ordered three drinks, three mains, and one appetizer, and the bill came out to a steep $200. For the price, we expected much more in terms of both flavor and presentation.

For the appetizer, we tried the tomato flatbread, which was forgettable and lacked any real punch. As for the mains, we had the tacos, croque madame, and ahi tuna bowl. The barbacoa in the tacos was the only highlight—tender and flavorful—but the rest of the dish, like the other mains, felt bland and uninspired.

The service didn’t redeem the experience either. Our server was distant and somewhat curt, making the overall atmosphere less enjoyable. While not outright rude, their standoffishness added to the sense that the restaurant has lost the charm it once had.

In the end, Mowry & Cotton felt like an overpriced and underwhelming dining experience. With a bill that high, I was hoping for something memorable, but instead, it felt like a letdown. I give it a 4/10 and probably won’t be returning anytime soon.

We were excited to try this restaurant but overall had a bad experience because of the service. When you order an appetizer and salad I expect that to come out first as a starter, the bread than the salad. Instead the server brought everything all out at once with the main entrees rather than coursed out. I told her that because she brought it all out at the same time our ribeye steak would get cold as we ate the appetizer and salad first. She did nothing about it and said she just thought we wanted it all out at once. I can’t think of any fine dining restaurant that would serve food like this and not apologize or do something to make it right. Instead, it ruined our experience and we don’t plan on going back.

We had dinner there on a Saturday night and brought our 5 year old son. There was another couple there sitting next to us with a young child as well. The kids menu was good and our son liked the food. The service was great. Our waitress was on top of things. I had the halibut (fish of the day) and it was really good. The side of heirloom carrots were really tasty too. We also shared the sausage flatbread and it was pretty good. The drinks were a little pricey but we expected that at the Phoenician. The ambience is great and they really make the place look lit up and classy. We will be going back soon but for a date night next time.
The Phoenician is a gorgeous property! Went for Restaurant Week and did the tasting menu. It did not disappoint. Food was amazing, tasty cocktails and gorgeous views. Staff was friendly and attentive
Restaurant week menu was amazing! I would love to go back
We visited for the first time for Restaurant  Week and enjoyed every bit. Will definitely be back.
As a local resident I have to say the food and service were all very worthy of representing our Phoenician culinary experience.
Delicious food, great service. Especially enjoyed the local melon salad
The Mowry & Cotton had some  lovely and unique flavor profiles. The  food was very fresh, very flavorful and very delicious!

They offered (Website) Brunch. Actually there was no Brunch but a regular Menue. The service was bad - for half an hour the remaining food on next table was welcomed by a bunch of nasty, loud and disturbing birds. So - for a 5 Starhotel it was over all disappointing.
Food was excellent and our server Big Al was knowledgeable and fantastic
What an amazing meal! Always great service! We are already excited for our next visit
Our host was great knowledge about the dishes and spot on with her recommendation.

Brussell sprouts were too salty to eat.  Salmon was overcooked.  Service was polite, but "drop the ball" on a few simple but needed requests.  No vegan entree choices at all.  Considering the price and the fact we were celebrating my wife's birthday, I have to say that I was disappointed and unlikely to revisit.
Food was delicious.  Waiter was super attentive.  Such a fun night!
Really amazing food. Quick service and everyone was so kind! The cocktails we had at the bar before our meal were really good, too.
My husband and I came for dinner to celebrate our anniversary.  It was our first time to restaurant and everyone was super friendly.  The food was perfect!  We will be returning.
We visited during Restaurant week. Food was amazing and well curated.

We went to Mowry & Cotton for Restaurant Week and really enjoyed the ambiance and the service (thank you Hector).  Our appetizers of meatballs was flavorful, while the salad could have been a bit more inspiring.  The entrees of the salmon was some of the best I have ever eaten, but the steak could was not medium rare as ordered, and the redo was really charred on the top, but still rare in the middle.  The desserts for caliber of restaurant was uninspiring, the chocolate cake was dry (not moist and fresh) and the pineapple upside down cake was looked mighty decorative, but it was hosed with super sweet syrup that took away any flavor it might have had.
The service was fantastic and the food delicious.

Drinks were good. The meat balls were very good. The hanger steak was very chewy. The lamb papperadelle had little lamb and the pasta was very doughy. The chocolate cake was OK. A poor meal. We would not go back.
Love the food, views, and service at the restaurant! Jordan is great and we always have a wonderful experience
Everything about the setting and meal was beyond perfection. Kudos to Hector, our very kind waiter. We will return regardless of it being Restaurant Week or not.

A little underwhelming to be honest as an overall experience. The service was great and the views speak for themselves. Great inside and outside tables. Just a little too quiet and boring for dinner. The menu and food aren't as good as other places nearby for dinner options. There's a lot of potential here, but it did fall a little short in our book. If the food quality and menu were elevated, and maybe adding more ambiance and music to make the restaurant and vibe more lively, I think this place would greatly benefit moving forward.
Our server was great! Very antintive and the food came out quick. The food was fair at best.

My wife and I went for restaurant week and had a truly wonderful dinner.  My wife had the salmon which was perfectly prepared and tasty.  I had the hanger steak and it was superb, cooked to perfection and accompanied by some very interesting tastes including blue berries.  We both had the caesar salad which was also very good, particularly the crutons which were not too hard and not too soft.  The atmosphere on the outdoor dining is delightful and the service by Jordan was perfect.   We highly recommend this restaurant.
I’ve been going here for years and have never never had a bad meal. It’s exceptional food and exceptional service and a wonderful experience each time.
Our reservation was not honored as it was closed for a private event.

The service was average at best.   Upon being seated it took about 10 mins before our server took drink orders.    We didn’t get water for the table until 45 mins into the meal.   The food was ok.  For example,  “duck hash” typically means a “hash”, not slices of duck sausage with potato slices.

We won’t be going back to this restaurant.    There are much better experiences for the same cost.

The menu selection was very limited for a brunch. No offers to refill mimosa or iced tea. Taco shells were overdone and meat filling was dry. Quality of the food was average. Service was good except for missing follow-up on beverages.
Outstanding & beautiful restaurant!! Ambiance is spot on gorgeous. Food was delicious & prices fair for where it's located. Absolutely delicious!!! Staff was very accommodating & polite.
Cassie was AMAZING.  All the staff was super friendly and helpful.   Amazing experience didn’t want to leaven
Our waitress was OUTSTANDING! It is my friends birthday and she went out of her way to make her feel special, thank you so very much and we will be back again this week!

Breakfast is amazing.

Dinner not so great. Ordered steak rare….served medium. Side’s….white asparagus, brussels sprouts….., broccolini all three were disappointing. Asparagus and  broccolini undercooked/hard. Brussels sprouts  average.

The food was amazing. I only reduced the rating as they forgot our appetizers, which were the monkey bread and fries, and although they didn’t charge for them, we were so full that we couldn’t enjoy them when they finally arrived at the end of our meal.

Our group of 9 arrived at different times and our Server was able to accommodate us with absolute grace and efficiency even though she was responsible for many tables bedside ours. Food was good. Biscuits, of course, were great as advertised. Special meatballs were probably the tastiest we ever had, and this is from a mostly Italian family. Again, the service was outstanding with other servers assisting our Sever as needed. Great teamwork.
Shrimp and grits were bad tasting replaced with a burger, and that was undercooked versus being well done as requested. Horrible value exchange will never return here again.
Wonderful venue, the service, food, and ambiance were fantastic.  If there is one negative, it is not easy to find once you are on site.

“Easter Brunch” ..terrible! Restaurant was totally unprepared. I made reservation well in advance, we were looking forward to it. We dressed for the occasion arrived,and that’s when all of the disappointment started. Waited quite a while to even be seated, service was extremely slow, an hour into our reservation still did not have drink service. Portions are small food didn’t even look appetizing, when it did arrive. Then, several items missing from our order. We brought this to management/staff attention, items were still never delivered! Just an OVERALL DISAPPOINTMENT! I don’t feel it was our server, I just think bad management.
Food was OK. Went for brunch wasn’t that impressed. Not sure I would go back for the price.

Good food, though service is super slow.  Not many people on a Saturday night, but … then again it’s not convenient to find, park, etc.  Pricing is high, as well.  $24 for an old fashioned.  $15+ for a glass of wine.  $40+ for main course and all other food is al cart!
Lovely setting. Food was okay. Menu felt a bit limited. But very expensive.
Dinner was absolutely delicious and our server, Gloria , was perfect.

Not impressed and we won’t return. It’s on site and it’s pretty. Our appetizer of the Buttermilk buns and veal meatballs were good. My steak was ordered medium and arrived well done. Our server did ask me to check it before she left the table which I appreciated. Sadly we ate our anniversary dinner separately since my wife’s hot meal wouldn’t be hot if she had waited the almost 10 minutes it took to get a corrected steak. They also sat a family of 4 right next to us that arrived with a crying toddler who never stopped which was poor hostessing.

It was our first time.  A beautiful place.  Our server was very helpful and attentive. The menu is varied and interesting.  I had the hangar steak and my wife had the sea bass. They were both delicious.  We will be back.

A huge disappointment. We sat out on the patio. It was a pleasant day, and they even had heaters if you needed them. The service was very slow. 45 minutes after we ordered I asked to see the waiter and asked him. Where was our lunch. He said yeah. Yeah it’s coming up. When the food got there, the french fries were cold. Nothing besides, the setting was up to par.
I purposely went to this restaurant because of the great reviews. Maybe I caught them on a bad day? But very disappointing and expensive for what we got.

Stellar experience from start to finish! We received the warmest welcome, and Tim guided us to a lovely outdoor table and even bright over an umbrella for shade. Chris, our server, was excellent and attentive! Our cocktails were expertly balanced and the dishes were delicious (they even sent over some fresh fruit as a courtesy since a large order went in right before ours- we didn’t even notice any delay - everything was still timed perfectly, but the gesture was so generous!) The ambiance is lovely. It was truly an unforgettable brunch. Highly recommend!
Excellent service. Very nice ambiance.   Quiet dining with a beautiful view.
Cassy was wonderful!! Excellent food.  Very pleased with our visit.
Such a beautiful hotel and the food was delicious

Beautiful restaurant with a large outdoor patio. Service was great! Had dinner here, the food was good but a slightly too expensive. Would be nice if they offered a happy hour. They did cook the filet perfectly though!
Unbelievable creations - both food and cocktails.  It was so fantastic we returned the following evening for more.
Dinner was sublime for our group of three.  One might also say magical.

It was my first time dining there and the food was absolutely delicious, patio was lovely, servers excellent and I have not had that great of service in years. Thank you and I will be back again soon.
The view is incredible but everything we ordered came out lukewarm or almost cold. We are staying at the resort but we won’t go back.
Good food but lousy service. Avocado toast is amazing.  Monkey bread has tamarind so it’s tangy not sweet.

We ate here back in September when we stayed at The Suites. We celebrated our anniversary at this resort and had dinner one night at Mowry & Cotton. The food is consistently delicious and the staff is warm, friendly, and very attentive. An excellent choice!
Beautiful setting, good food,.  Al our server was outstanding.
Lovely dinner! Great service and very beautiful. The salmon was outstanding.
Delicious food, beautiful ambience, excellent service by Christian!
It took them 40 minutes just to get our drink order and the place wasn’t even busy.

Absolutely LOVED this place. From the time we walked in until the time we left, every single employee went above and beyond! The food was outstanding, delicious cocktails, all while having the most beautiful view. We will definitely be back!
Very good experience. Food delicious. Server very good. Great table outside with heater. Fun birthday dinner.

We had high expectations for our visit, but unfortunately, it fell short. The food was served cold and undercooked, prompting us to send it back. The service was inattentive and mediocre at best. It’s disappointing when anticipation doesn’t match the reality of the dining experience.
Although the menu was somewhat limited, the price of and all items received, as well as our servers,  especially our waitress Cassandra was exceptional, thank you. We will be back and bring others.

What a wonderful evening. Amazing food, amazing service.

We will be back

Cassie was our server and she was amazing. Super nice and friendly. Even with multiple tables she had to help she still checked up on us a reasonable amount of times. Thank you for making our anniversary amazing.

We are locals and went to the Phoenician for an evening out. It was a mistake this time. At the bar area, we waited roughly 25 minutes for a couple pre dinner drinks. Then, after arriving at our reservation time we were offered and seated outside, but the waitress didn’t know how to operate the heater and abandoned us to the elements. Someone eventually figured it out and got a heater going, but it took awhile. Then, after about 30 minutes waiting on a simple bottle of wine (with no one having checked in with us or offering to take any portion of our food order in the interim) we decided to cut our losses and went out for pizza at another restaurant.
Wonderful scenery and amazing food for brunch!  Outdoors with a view and heaters to accommodate.￼

Went for early dinner on New Year’s Eve so this likely affected experience to be fair. Nice place but food was just okay especially for price (fixed $110 per person). Basic cocktail $23. Bill for two adults with one drink each after tip was over $300. Would have been fine with it if food had been really good but honestly it was just okay
The food and service were fantastic at this beautiful restaurant.
The meal from starter to dessert was outstanding.

Adam, my server, was an absolute delight!!!
I had a great dinner!!
Great food, and ambiance will definitely do this again when I am back.

This started off great and took an odd turn. We booked a table outside because we have a small dog that we confirmed was permitted when making the reservation, then again when the restaurant confirmed the reservation that morning, and again when we entered the restauarant. We are those empty nesters who bought a dog stroller of which he slept the majority of time. The weather was quite chilly which is probably why there were only two other tables outside, but it was odd that our food was taking forever.  It was Christmas Eve, we ate lite during the day, since we booked a 5PM reservation and boy, we were famished. The waiter and his curious personality brought an apology appetizer and said the restaurant was backed up which I'm guessing were for the tables inside. Anyhow, we woke our fur baby from his nap to walk around the property while we were still waiting and upon return to our table the manager was telling our adult daughter dogs weren't allowed. Our daughter said she was very kind about it, but that we basically needed to wrap up our meal we were still waiting for. The dinner then came right out and all the meat was undercooked. Had dogs not been allowed, we wouldn't have taken him. So weird that amount of times they said they were.
Excellent service and good, great ambiance and the staff was first rate
Perfect place to celebrate my birthday.  The service was impeccable. We sat outside and the views are breathtaking

Adam was my server and he was amazing and wonderful.  He has a wonderful personality and the bartender Raul makes amazing drinks. I just found my favorite place to come. The staff was so very friendly and I felt so welcomed
Appetizer, main course, desert, drinks, service by Al - fabulous!!
Jordan is a great server! Friendly and very knowledgeable with their menu! Would highly recommend the restaurant and him

My husband and I were staying at The Phoenician for a wedding last weekend that had brought many of our family members to the same area. We thought it would be nice to get together for brunch before the wedding, and decided on Mowry and Cotton as it was convenient and had good reviews. The staff at the restaurant went out of their way to accommodate our party of 12 when I made the reservation the night before brunch. They showed us to a private dining area which allowed all of us to talk and enjoy the morning. The food was exceptional, and all staff we encountered were extremely friendly and helpful. It was a wonderful experience, and my husband and I are so glad we chose Mowry and Cotton for our family brunch!
Food and service was great, outdoor seating was amazing.  Looking forwards to returning soon.
Very nice meal in quiet beautiful setting. Efficient service and nicely presented and flavorful food.
Our server Christopher was extremely nice and very attentive to our needs. Overall we had a wonderful evening dining there.

Always a creative and delicious menu at Mowry & Cotton. Their menu changes seasonally with local ingredients so there's always something different to look forward to. Additionally, I can always count on the entire experience being 5 stars.

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Mowry and Cotton in Scottsdale, AZ for a business lunch, and I must say, it was quite the experience!

The atmosphere at Mowry and Cotton is what I'd call bougie chic - a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. It's the kind of place that makes you feel special as soon as you walk in.

Our waiter, Ernesto, deserves a special mention. He was not only attentive but also incredibly knowledgeable about the menu, helping us make some fantastic choices.

As for the food, it was absolutely delicious. I opted for the burger, and it was cooked to perfection, juicy and flavorful. My colleagues went for the ahi tuna, and they raved about how fresh and tasty it was.

LOVED IT SO MUCH GOING BACK TODAY!
We for for my wife’s birthday and had a wonderful experience. The service, the food and the ambiance were fantastic!

Took  friend to lunch -- and everything was just okay.   The host wasn't paying attention and gave our table away to other people, resulting in a much longer than expected wait time.  The menu is kind of drab -- a couple salads, and not much to spark our attention.  The friendliest person there was the gentleman with the hawk.   Disappointing.  Just meh.
Service was one of the worst experiences we’ve had to date anywhere. Ruined our whole meal. Will not return. Dining is much more enjoyable at the poolside cafe or with room service.
Delicious and creative cocktails.  Entrees had excellent presentation and very flavorful.
Great wine list and good food. Good kids menu. Would recommend

Wife and I both get the Avocado Caesar with grilled salmon when at M&C.  It’s consistently a great healthy meal.  We live nearby yet sitting outside you feel like you’re on vacation.  Service is as good as the meal.  We love Al and Hector.  Prices have been creeping up.  2 salads w/salmon, 2 ice teas, tax and tip is $92.
Our server Kayla was great.  The patio was gorgeous, with misters and great views - we even saw a llama (Private event on the lawn)  Food was excellent (Those meatballs!)
Hanger steak was delicious! Service was great. Nice view of the pool.

Fabulous!
Always a great experience and  fabulous service!
We are going back tonight!
wonderful food, responsive and friendly staff, and amazing views!
Im a foodie, zonafoodiegirl on social media and I absolutely love your place!!! I will be sharing across all platforms- to try your place. All the way amazing and yummy!!

Excellent view and food! Dined inside due temperature outside. Jenna was an amazing server!! 
Try the corn soup…so good! Large enough to share!
The food was excellent and the service was outstanding!

While the food was excellent the whole patio atmosphere was awful .. terrible lighting & teak outdoor tables . Service was not great … we kept having to search for our server & finally resorted to asking another  server to help us . Not what i was expecting from a high end hotel
Service was excellent. The falconer added a great touch to the overall experience.

Not sure why this place has so many negative reviews. First thing you need to find the parking, rather then driving all the way upto main entrance, park in the underground parking its $10 for 4 hours, but restaurants validates the parking.
Service here is great, staff is super polite and very considerate to your needs. Food here was decent, had shakshuka and chicken sandwich. Broiche bread for the sandwich was super soft and shakshuka was very flavorful.

My GF and I went to M&C for AZ Restaurant Week.  Had not been to the Phoenician Resort prior.  The food was delicious, the service was impeccable, and the ambiance was relaxing.
I would certainly come back and try the regular menu.
Found out they serve breakfast starting at 7a.

I've wanted to go to this restaurant since it re-opened after Covid. The wait was worth it!  The food is fresh from farm to table., and the ambiance was perfect on the patio. Quiet and the nature sounds of the birds was fun.

Wonderful restaurant. Amazing service from Tom the manager. Make sure you meet him!  The servers are also the best. Delicious food!  I worked every morning from the restaurant and it was quite and peaceful.

Was a terrific experience.  Unfortunately, I do not remember our server's name but she was great.  I had the sausage flatbread and it was amazing.  Husband had the steak with pesto sauce and side of crispy potatoes.  Would highly recommend!

We had dinner at 7:00 pm last night. The restaurant was pretty much empty at first with the exception of a large party of two tables of maybe 30 people. They seated us not far from them. Let me explain -this is a fairly large restaurant -and it has a private room that can be closed off. However this group was not in that room and while off to the side, their voices carried a lot! So much so that the three of us were basically yelling across the table at times.

About 20 minutes later a few more groups came in and were seated further from our area. Now the restaurant was about 1/3 filled. One of the groups had some very raunchy speaking individuals who did not care that everyone could hear what they said. A family with a young child asked the party to watch what they were saying and ended up moving away from that group.

The next issue arose when we went to order. One of us tried to order the hanger steak and the server came back to say there were none left. Now it was 7:15pm in a restaurant that was hardly filled and they were out of it. Plus it is restaurant week. The steak is one of two entrees being offered. You are telling me that they under ordered one of their two promoted entrees?

There is good in this review-the food was very good. The entree portions were on the small side for the price. Our server was also very nice and kept checking back on us.

Overall, I’m not running back anytime soon. This is a nice restaurant in a five star resort. It needs to start acting that way and so should it’s patrons.

Our dinners at Mowry are pretty simple.  Two Avocado Caesar salads with grilled salmon along with two Arnold palmers.   We love the salads.   The grilled salmon is perfectly cooked and a decent size.   
The Phoenician is easy to park.  Alan and Hector are our favorite servers and treat us like family.  Kudos to both of them.  Kudos to M&C.

Service was not good but the food was delicious. Very slow night but still had bad service. The manager was very nice and did what she could to make our evening enjoyable.

We are all human and you never know what is going on in someone’s life. Last night his mind wasn’t into work.

Beautiful place.
I love the place, The food is so delicious and I enjoyed every bite.

The food is very good. The ambiance is lovely, as is the service. My only complaint is that the serving size is incredibly minuscule for the price point, particularly for the children’s menu. We travel to dozens of Bonvoy properties each year (we are Titanium members) and I was shocked by how small the portions are for the price. We ended up  having to purchase two kids breakfasts per kid, because the serving was so tiny. If I had known that, I would have just ordered from the adult menu to begin with. Just know, the restaurant is convenient, but you will not get your money’s worth.

Warm and friendly reception. The environment is pleasant and well-decorated. The service was outstanding and the food was excellent. Great presentation that really appealed to the eyes and taste buds.

One of the best dining experiences we have had in a while.   Menu was incredibly diverse with some very interesting options. We ordered a bunch of appetizers, salads and a meal to split between us.  Everything was fantastic- would encourage others to do the same to really enjoy the experience
Food was AMAZING! The ambiance was nice and every employee we came in contact with was so kind
We had a pleasant and good dinner, with very friendly and courteous service.
First time in a while where I could say that I received exceptional service.  Food was delicious as well.

This restaurant is excellent.  We ate there two nights in a row because we liked it so much.  The wait staff is outstanding and the manager came by our table both nights to ensure we had a great experience.  I have traveled all over the world and great service is hard to find.  This restaurant has figured it out and we will be back the next time we are in Arizona.  Excellent!
Adam was amazing! Excellent service and kind hospitality. The food was delicious
The food had no flavor . Overpriced for what you get. Service was good.
The staff at Mowry and Cotton are top notch!! Excellent food, perfectly prepared every time! A bit pricey but worth the experience!
Great meal & great service! You can't go wrong with the hangar steak.
Amazing. We love heading to brunch here. Monkey bread is 10/10 amazing. Will be going again and again.
The ambience and food is excellent, the chairs are very comfortable.  The noise level inside, however, is distracting.  When the weather permits, outside is definitely better.

Food choices was okay, taste was basic but presentation was really nice. Good amount of serving especially for the 3 course options. Dessert was really tasty and unique. It took a while for my husband and son’s entree to come in, so me and my other 2 sons ate first. Service was okay too. DJ was very friendly, professional and attentive when we had him. The only thing is, we were seated separately from his group and a little far from the rest, so it took a while for him to round on us each time. Our seat was nice though considering, because it was more private and quiet. Overall, our dinner was okay.
Overly sweet cocktails with under seasoned entrees. Nice service though.

Amazing restaurant service was superb
Energetic atmosphere

Not what I expected at the Phoenician. Food was served hot. However every dish had some issue. Service was mediocre. We had to constantly ask for things such as small plates to eat appetizers on. Clean silverware. My guest indicted the service was on par with D——‘s. (Unnamed but national chain for breakfast) Not worth the money.
Service was great, as well as food!! Though trying  to find the restaurant from the parking garage is a bit of a hassle.
Great food. Our server Jenna was fantastic. Beautiful location

We arrived 10 minutes late and were seated instantly.  That’s were everything fell apart from there.  After 5 minutes we received water.  15 minutes later a waiter came by and asked if he could get us drinks?  However he instantly let us know that “I’m not your waiter.”  After another 15 minutes we had not received our drinks and decided to leave.  It was not busy but obviously something was missing, maybe management?

Food quality was terrible 
View was nice, you cannot see sunset from here, just the pool.
Lovely view, fabulous food, great service!  Jorge was amazing.
Tried out this location for Sunday brunch…amazing! Food was delicious and the drinks were ice cold. Will return! 10/10

We felt betrayed on our 5/28/2023 reservation @ 1:45pm. We arrived on time. FYI there is no easy way for handicapped individuals to avoid stairs in order to arrive at the restaurant. Once seated we were excited because it was Arizona Restaurant Week yet we were promptly told that the AZ Restaurant Week offer only applied to dinner time and they were in brunch mode. We left disappointed in being misled. There is no reason for us to return. Shame on you.
Jordan was amazing! Great food, cocktails, ambiance and service.

Our meal at Mowry & Cotton was decent but certainly nothing more than that. The serving portion of the salmon was downright laughable. It was perhaps half the size of the smallest salmon portion I have ever seen. It was comical but our server seemed earnest and new so I did not raise a fuss with the kitchen. But don't expect normal restaurant portions.
Food was great, Lexie and Johnny were amazing :) Thank you
Delicious upscale poolside restaurant. Fantastic service by Adam.
We really enjoyed the meal & service was excellent!  Thank you chef & Lexi!
Great place for lunch and a nice/relaxing view! Service was wonderful also!
Not enough healthy/vegetarian choices on the menu.

Perhaps it should have been a warning when we were asked to confirm our reservation via text, email and then by a call from the staff.  Although the front side (host/hostess) was well staffed and attentive, our polite server disappeared for long stretches of time.  We were seated at 12:30 and didn't get our check until almost two hours later.  We had young children in our party and having them wait so long was difficult.  The portions were modest and the food mediocre.  Despite it being Mother's Day, when crowds should be expected, they ran out of monkey bread even though the restaurant was not crowded while we were there.  The man walking around with the falcon unsettled some in our party thought he was polite.  Maybe this was a difficult day for the staff, but it became a bad and expensive one for us.

Our server Shelly was great!
The atmosphere was ver nice as well
Food was fantastic. Christian was the best server ever! Really enjoyed the phenomenal food, drinks and service!
Excellent brunch in a beautiful location! We had great service and delicious food served outdoors overlooking the scenic landscape of the resort
Steak Tartare rocked, exquisite presentation. Corn soup smooth as silk. Cowboy Ribeye med- rare OMG. Roasted carrots new on menu to die for. Crispy potatoes delicious as always

I attended the Derby party and well done!
We will return next year if offered.
Food was excellent. Waite Staff was exceptional.  Will return again.

One of the best restaurants I have ever eaten at.  My husband rarely gives high reviews of food and he was raving about everything he ate.  The best pork I have ever eaten.  The food was beyond yummy and looked so beautiful too.  We are going back tonight.  I want to try everything on the menu.  The restaurant has such a nice atmosphere and is unique.

Fabulous food and service!
Every time we ate there the service and food were excellent. The outdoor seating has beautiful views.
We can’t wait to return.
Delicious food, excellent service, nice setting - even a falconer with a trained falcon to keep birds away from the portion of eating area that was outdoors.

The restaurant is in a beautiful setting overlooking the Phoenician pool area,  We chose to be seated out doors and it was a fun view of the pool. The people watching was great and the misters provided a cool environment. The food was good, not great, I had the mushroom flat bread and my husband had the eggs benedict. Portions are medium to small, and the quality of the food is above average. Our wait staff were friendly and professional. Over all it was a good experience.

We enjoyed this place for the atmosphere and the food. However the service was awful. A middle aged woman named Shelly did not take care of us and had an attitude if we flagged her down. My sister had foil in her Barbacoa tacos and no one ever came to check it out. I had to get up, walk inside and locate someone to help us. Our drinks were empty the whole meal so I asked to see the manager to report the poor service and it took them 10 mins to locate him. The lack of service ruined an otherwise good experience.
Muscles and panzanella salad were fantastic! View and service were top tier.

The service was outstanding, the food was great, especially the shrimp and grits dish.  The noise/ music from the pool was a little annoying, but otherwise a wonderful place to sit and enjoy a good meal
Wonderful food and great service. Our server was awesome but I unfortunately cannot remember his name to shout him out. If you come here, be sure to try the meat balls. Would go back.

Very nice experience 
Excellent food and good service. Ambience was nice.

A lovely setting with a very average dining experience. Food was below expectation for a resort of this caliber. Service was adequate, certainly making no effort to enhance our dining experience. Dessert, chocolate cake, was so dry it was inedible for $12.00. The four of us, who all live locally, decided we will not be going back.
Quite place for lunch/brunch.  Comfortable, great food
Great service and absolutely delicious food. Perfect experience.

I will start with the beautiful grounds on the property. Next the staff was friendly and very professional. The food would be hard to beat, especially considering her in a fair price. Or one regret was that we were not seated closer to the beautiful outdoor scenery as there were multiple open tables that would’ve provided that exceptional experience. We will return.
This is our special place for anniversaries and celebrating important events.  I have never been disappointed and in fact each and every time it is a wonderful experience.
Wonderful food, servers and atmosphere. We’ll be back!

Tom and I are staying at The Phoenician for the fourth time. We enjoy dining at Mowry & Cotton for our first night after a long day of airplane travel. The appetizers, salads, entrees, desserts, and cocktails ALWAYS are perfectly delicious. The wait staff are professionals - attentive and courteous. Make this a must dining stop whenever you are in Scottsdale!
Great meal and great service. Once again, the Phoenician is the best place to stay and dine in Arizona!
Had to ask for silverware , twice. Same for table next to us. Birds were bothersome. Food was fast , hot and delicious.
Nice so day brunch on a great patio overlooking Scottsdale. Tasty food, good service.

Lovely patio with the added fun of a falconer and his hawk keeping small birds away from the tables! Excellent food — flatbread large enough to share between two plus really  interesting flavors in the apple, fennel guacamole. Thoroughly enjoyed everything.
Enjoyed the wonderful atmosphere and great food. Beautiful resort and wonderful service
The service was very good. The setting is lovely. The food was ok. The chicken was dry. The lettuce in the bowls was wilted. The mock tails and the Phoenician tea were very good.
Food was good. Server was wonderful and very attentive.
An innovative and diverse menu served by a genuinely warm, knowledgeable and gracious staff.

Although it wasn’t busy, theee were many miscues. Hot bread was cold (x3!).  Wine ordered for dinner was brought to table only once we had finished eating so we sent it back.  Food was good but for this price they need to up the ante.
Great atmosphere & fun birthday
The environment and service were impeccable. The food was good, but not great.
We had a wonderful experience! Everything we ordered was delicious and the service was top-notch.
Amazing location in a fabulous resort. Very expensive for the quality of food and service.
Nice patio area for a quiet lunch.  Very attentive and professional wait staff.

Friends and I were visiting Scottsdale for a few days and had lunch at Mowry and Cotton on our last day. It's located in the Phoenician Resort, and has both indoor and outdoor seating. After we were seated, our drinks and appetizers took forever: two of our drinks arrived after 20 minutes (a glass of wine and a soft drink); my husband's after 25 (a whiskey sour); and our appetizers took 35 minutes (fires and a charcuterie board). Even though we were seated right next to the server station, we were regularly waving staff down to refill our water glasses. The appetizers were very good, but the lunch options were limited. My MC signature chop salad was tasty, and my husband's brisket sandwich was good, but neither meal was exceptional--certainly not given the price. Visit the Phoenician for the great views--which raised my rating from two stars to three--but don't expect luxury service at this restaurant.

Our group was very unimpressed with this restaurant. The menu was extremely overpriced for the food and drinks. Both were underwhelming. The ambiance and service were lacking in many ways.
Food was phenomenal and service was too!!

We expected a much more elegant menu given the top quality of the hotel and their award winning honor of best new restaurant in 2017.  After we moved past that surprise we settled in for some regular ole comfort food and all turned out fine.  Wine list is quite interesting, but would seem to pair better with a bit more upscale menu.  Server did a fine job.

Noise level is not moderate.  It was quiet and romantic. (Opentable needs to fix their software)

Our lunch was absolutely delicious and the service by Rachele was great. She walked us through the menu and gave wonderful recommendations. It started to rain during our lunch. We were quickly accommodated at another table that kept us from getting rained on. 

I look forward to coming back for dinner as the menu looks stellar!
Outrageously expensive and not good at all.  Dishes missing components and overcooked.
Outstanding service. Very comfortable, with proper spacing and patio heaters. The meatball starter is not to be missed.

We could not have asked for a more serene location on the patio - facing the pool and the Phoenix skyline.  Our waiter was friendly and attentive, and asked where we were from and why we moved to the area.  Our appetizers were simple, but quite good.  The housemade buns with butter and the veal meatballs were a fun start.  The wine list is concise, but entirely new world.  We enjoyed our California pinot noir, but a few more electic picks would add some versatility to the menu.  Our entrees were good.  Again, simple, but well composed.  The pork steak was a fun riff on Asian flavors, but a touch over salted.  It is a beautiful space in a beautiful part of the city.  We had breakfast the following morning and also enjoyed our experience.  Overall, unpretentious but well done.  Stylish but not stuffy.  Kid-friendly as well as good for a romantic dinner.  Would recommend.
The food was exceptional. Great variety on the menu. A bit pop rivet, but the overall experience was great!!!
Thanks for acknowledging our birthday celebration we enjoyed the special treat

Lovely time here. Sat out on the covered patio. View is overlooking the pool. Food very good. Service was right on time. Attentive but not looming. Lots of families with children but not particularly noisy. Suggested a walk in the cactus garden after our meal which was great in the star filled night. We would fine here again next time we are in town.
Our server, Giovanna, seemed rushed and disinterested in serving us. She just seems annoyed ever time she came over to our table.

Didn't like the feel of the restaurant. It's located inside of the very busy and loud resort. 
Starters were pretty good, especially shishito peppers! Seabass's presentation is very poor for that money!
The quality of food is not what I was expecting. The inside of my steak was cooked to the proper temperature but the outside was charred so badly that it was a struggle to cut it with a steak knife.

Amazing service and drinks. Our server was absolutely fantastic. The variety of food was awesome as well. Only complaint was that the food was a bit salty but I would still definitely recommend checking it out.
Loved the spinach artichoke appetizer and apple crostata dessert the most

Beautiful restaurant!  Wished we had better service from our waiter...he was hard to understand and did not provide the level of service that we expected for a five star hotel.  The food was outstanding and the valet was top notch.

The service was severely lacking. Our first order of drinks took about 40 minutes to get. We were almost halfway through our meal before they arrived.  We asked for a condiment and it took another 15 minutes. The food was average at best for a restaurant in a luxury hotel.   I heard the word sorry no less than a dozen times with no real contrition or discount on our meal.  

This was literally the worst dining experience I have ever had.

We had a nice dinner overlooking the pools.. 

The pace and timing of the meal was great. 

The food was properly prepared and served with style and class.

Outstanding food & outstanding service!
Great place to eat!
Amazing service ! Grate view ! Yummy food !

It was Saturday night, they were busy, didn't seem understaffed, or overly busy, seemed like a Saturday-8PM normal dinner rush. After we were sat, we didn't see a server for 18 minutes, we ordered apps and drinks, apps came before drinks, and drinks too an extra 15 minutes after apps were delivered. The apps were very good, the main courses were ok. Overall wasn't satisfied with the price + service. Their Bourbon & Boujee cocktail was 5-star, I did order a second, and it wasn't the same drink.
Beautiful location.  Food was inconsistent.  The chicken was delicious but other entrees were just average or below.  For the price, the value wasn't there.
We had such a nice brunch at Mowry & Cotton, the view overlooking the pool and golf course was amazing, and the food was incredible! Will definitely come back next time visiting Scottsdale!
Service was not the best, food was okay. Overall was expecting much better food and service.
Very good service, decent wine selection, & fantastic view outside!

We are staying at The Phoenician and had dinner here on our first night. Food was amazing and service was great too! I have a dairy allergy & the waitress was so kind to find out what I could and couldn’t have. I had the salmon (amazing), my husband had the cod (amazing). Our kids he the cheese flatbread and burger- also amazing. Will be coming back every time we visit the area!
Amazing service, food, restaurant was nice and clean!
The food was slightly below their usual standard. The service was good. I'll come back and I would recommend Mowry and Cotton to friends.
Wonderful outdoor seating. Quality luncheon menu. Very good service, friendly and welcoming. Overall excellent experience.
Amazing! Definitely coming back! We loved the atmosphere and the food was amazing!
Terrible service
Wry limited menu and so so food. Very pricey for what you get.
Nice and relaxing location in a very nice resort.  Had lunch there and will be back again soon
Incredible view and atmosphere, great food and all around fun time. And our waitress Dora was incredible!
Great meal and no rushing from server.
Great experience.
Great experience, as always. Dora was our waiter, she made our time there even better.

We dined here for Valentine's Day and it was absolutely sublime! We opted for the special menu for the occasion, trying both dishes offered. We added on our favorite Buttermilk Buns with their delicious duck fat butters. All of the dishes were delicious, but the Seafood Pasta was out of this world! And we finished it off with their decadent French Silk pie. We have never left the restaurant unhappy, unsatisfied, or with an empty stomach, and this visit was no different. It has become our favorite restaurant for our dates and anniversaries.

One recommendation for the restaurant would be to please add a Moscato, preferably a D'Asti, to your wine list.
Terrible service. Waitress lost track of her tables on many occasions. After initially seated, waited 25 minutes for the waitress to come over.

It’s a nice atmosphere with a good menu. They messed up for out of the four entrées, did not bring one of the sides, and one of the sides was completely under cooked. For the price the execution should be much much better. It’s not somewhere I would recommend for people not staying at the hotel have other options.
It was a perfect outdoor dining experience. Great for lunch.
Great ambience.   Easy valet parking.  Food was excellent.  Service was a little slow but the waiter was very friendly and respectful.
Casual light lunch. Nice atmosphere
Best place to enjoy a luxury weekend and some awesome food!
The place was delicious and the view was beautiful!! It was super relaxing eating there!!
Everything from start to finish was spit on.  It was chilly that evening and they made our outside table perfect.   Our server was amazing. Our beef entrees were cooked perfectly
It was. Nice experience with some good food and ambience
Had a great lunch. Atmosphere was wonderful and the waiter was excellent and very attentive!

Not sure what was going on the night we visited but it certainly did not live up to our expectations especially considering the rating of this restaurant. We recognized that our server was new and he was polite but management in the least should have had someone backing him up. Half our dishes were not at the proper temperature, drinks ordered before our meal
arrived after we had finished (45 min later), and dessert never came. Twice a manager came to the table to apologize and comped our drinks which were delivered after our meal was finished but he really should have comped the entire meal. There were gaps of a half hour during which not one person from the wait staff checked on our table of 8. The outdoor venue is lovely but they need more staffing and to get their act together.
Austin was an exceptional server

The perfect location to celebrate a special occasion. The outdoor seating was lovely and inviting. We were first-timers from out of town but look forward to the return. Three things to remember:  the Buttermilk Bun, the Avocado Caesar Salad, and the Ribeye with Gorgonzola Dolce. Heavenly!

Server Samantha was wonderful: chatty, informative, and brought drinks/food quickly. The food was perfect: meatballs, pasta, apple dessert, all delicious! I usually don’t care too much for soup, but decided to order their winter squash soup and WOW! It even has toasted marshmallows; one of the best soups I’ve ever had. The place also has safe covid measures: staff wore masks properly, tables were distanced, saw them sanitizing tables/chairs after people left. Will definitely return!

The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting. Dined for both dinner and breakfast during my stay at The Phoenician. The food was very good and offered a fresh take on staples (calamari, pancakes, "hash"). The thing that stood out the most was the incredible wait staff. I can't say enough about Christine Lam and Sam. Both helped us during breakfast. They were both so professional, but made me feel at home. I definitely felt like I was among friends and enjoyed their personal service. Our every request was met with a smile. Truly a memorable experience and I look forward to dining at Mowry and Cotton again soon.
We went for dinner on a beautiful evening to enjoy the resort.  Husband had the cod and I had the filet.  Both dishes along with our mashed and carrot sides were delish!
We had a wonderful evening with great drinks, starters, entrees and deserts. our server, Luis, was perfect. Can't wait to go back.
