Raul, the bartender, made this experience amazing. While waiting in the bar for the rest of our party, Raul gave us some history about the resort as well as having fun with his amazing mixology talents. His friendliness and creativity was over the top. We'd return just to hang with him! 

As far as dinner, our server was fantastic! Our friends ordered the bone in ribeye and shared. It looked incredibly. My filet tasted good but I wasn't impressed with the presentation. It was 6 oz but was only about 1/2-3/4" tall. I ordered it charred and medium rare. It was cooked correctly but looked like it had sat under a warmer for awhile. The sides were fabulous!
Wonderful staff and great consistent food.  Love sitting outside on the patio!
For one of the upscale restaurants in a high caliber resort, we expected more.
A fantastic place for a romantic dinner, or in our case - a nice girls night out. Seating on the patio was perfect.
Our waitress Samantha and staff were amazing. The food, top notch. We will be back and will recommend this place to everyone. Thanks for a wonderful night/dinner
Great dining experience and awesome food.  We sat outside and the view of the pool was incredible!
Servers are very nice! Food is delicious and good sized for price.
Love the decor in the restaurant and the food was delicious!

Meal was great.  Service was slow to start up.  Great while he was attentive.  Then he completely dropped off at the end of the meal. We were not offered dessert or and then had to flag him down for the check.  The restaurant was not busy.

Our experience at Mowry & Cotton was delightful. We had a wonderful family dinner and evening. The view from the patio over looking the pool was breathtaking. Would recommend to any friend and will be back.

Food and ambiance was good.  Our server Alysia was out of it, drinks took a long time or were forgotten along with other things and she just seemed aloof as to what was going on around her.  I waited tables before, so it was not as if she was in the weeds as it was later in the evening and things were somewhat slow.  We were staying at the hotel so we ate breakfast there two other days and that waiter was good.  Hopefully management will read this and spend some time Alysia in order to get her up to speed.
Our server was awesome! She made great recommendations and offered to change things if we did not like our orders.

Entrees we’re not that tasty. We had tbone and filets. Bread and sides were excellent. I had the lemon meringue and it seemed like it had been sitting a long time before serving. The whip cream balls on top were hardened. Not that good.
Good food but the service was less than attentive this time...last time the service was great

We had an outstanding dinner. The hanger steak is just amazing. 
Butternut squash soup is so good !!
Chef Tandy is a rockstar. Luis  is so professional and knowledgeable, he just has a great way about him. Ahmet the manager stopped by. He really embodies the concept of hospitality.
We had a great experience.
We also felt very safe. As everybody was wearing masks and gloves and sanitizing tables. Hats off to The Phoenician and all of the Mowry and Cotton staff

Excellent staff
Food good 
Not exceptional 
Very pleasant
Nice! The service was very good
Great food and ambience as well as wait staff. Would go again.
Patio was fantastic and there food was spectacular
Stayed at the hotel and dined here for several meals. Very pleased all the way around

Our waitress, Sabrina, was excellent!  She was enthusiastic and guided us through favorites on the menu.  She helped with wine pairings -- in the middle of the surging pandemic, it was a refreshing venue to have a relaxing dinner (social distancing was well established).

Everything was perfect except my rib eye steak.  It was cooked to medium rare as I requested, but it was not juicy, nor tasty and it was full of gristle and difficult to chew.  The server took it to the chef and they removed the cost from my bill.  The green beans with the interesting sauce were delicious and the apple dessert was fabulous.

Went back because it is not only super convenient when staying at the Phoenician, the food is delicious! Service was great both times. Gelato is an awesome treat. Double chocolate is the best. Patio has been converted to a wide, open space so that one feels safe but also like a normal night out.

This was our first time dining at Mowry & Cotton and we were not impressed.  Our table of 7 people had two servers who wouldn't let us enjoy our meal and kept on trying to rush us to order and leave so they could seat someone else at our table.  The food was mediocre and way overpriced.  I will not be returning.
Had such a great time there! My husband and I enjoyed our food and had the best server ever named Al! He was so nice and recommend the best old fashioned for my husband to drink!

Great ambience - wise patio. Lively and lots of space to spread out. We have tried several things on the menu but the best way to end the meal is with gelato. Dark chocolate is the best but so is the Phoenician. Great service and delicious options even for vegetarians. So good we came back!
Server Samantha was wonderful! Food was okay.

Have dined here before, and it was a wonderful experience.  This time around, there were a couple of issues.  Unfortunately I had to send the lamb back because it was cooked rare (practically raw). In addition, one of the dishes for our table took far too long (almost 40 minutes) and came about 20 minutes after all other meals arrived.  The food was delicious overall, but these mistakes definitely impacted our experience.

Mowry & Cotton was a great way to close out the week.  Great cocktails, starters and entrees (& dessert, too - chocolate tart was plenty and easily shared by 2).  Amazing flavors, nice ambiance (outdoor seating)...we will be back!

We came here for an anniversary dinner as we were staying at the hotel and to say this was place was a disappointment is an understatement. Our waitress could care less about our table (despite convincing us to order the most expensive wine on the list) and didn’t even know it was for our anniversary when the hostess did. When our food came out under cooked, she simply waited 30 minutes before asking 
 “oh, do want us to throw that back on the grill for you” after I had eaten around the raw salmon part and it was clearly too late to ask that question. Please don’t waste your money here. There are plenty of amazing restaurants in Scottsdale that you could have a fantastic dinner at AND would care about your business more than this place. We will not be back.
Great food and great place to eat outside
Great if staying at the Phoenician

This may be a COVID issue, but the quality of the food was really poor. My meal, chicken, had clearly been sitting under a warmer for 30+minutes. The vegetables were dry, the chicken was dry and had little seasoning. 
My co-diners reported similar experiences. Apparently, the steak was OK.
For these prices, you expect at least something palatable.

I hope they return the kitchen quality as covid abates and diners venture out more.
Great ambience and the food is delicious! Definitely recommend.

Our waitress was very good, the ambiance was nice, but as far as being the number 1 for lunch in Scottsdale? No way possible. The portions were appropriate, but the taste was nothing special. If I was staying there, yes I would eat there out of convenience, but I wouldn't go out of my way to go back

Service is always great. Food this time, not so much. Had the ribeye, was a bit cold and had a citrus flavor that was, well, not very good. We have dined here a number of times and this dinner left us both disappointed. Perhaps next time will be better. Again, the service was great and the atmosphere is very comfortable.

I love visiting the Phoenician as a local resident. Afternoon tea is my annual tradition. I tried Mowry & Cotton for the first time and it was amazing. Great  food, excellent service and a safe environment given the current Covid climate.

What a cute place~ very cozy and romantic. We loved sitting outside with views of the pool. Enjoyed sharing an app, salad and entree~ everything tasted fresh and was delish~ can’t wait to go back again.
My girlfriend and I had an incredible time here! The food was incredible and the cocktails were amazing. I would definitely come back here and recommend it to others!

Great cocktails, savory food,, nice ambiance.
Will go back!
Andres was fantastic. He made the dinner so great with his service and friendliness. Also surprised my bf with candles on his dessert which was a nice touch. Great guy!

A MUST!!! Amazing food & drinks. We were here for a girls weekend & were so happy we listened to the reviews and decided to go. The food was amazing. Wonderful selection and we all enjoyed our choices. So flavorful & delicious. 

We will definitely be back.
Just the best!

Birthday
Server was excellent!!!!!!

Our waitress was servicing other tables more so than ours. We had waited so long for her to come back after dinner that we had to ask another server to find her for us. Portions are small, food was good, but not great. Considering the location, I expected the food to be amazing, and it fell short. The calamari was great and the burger my son ordered looked great. But, the salmon is a very small portion, and Mary’s chicken was small as well. The flavor was good, but seemed like both sat a while before being served to us. If I could’ve tipped the support staff instead of our waitress, I would’ve. But they automatically add 20% to your bill for gratuity for a party of 6 or more.
It was a wonderful evening catching up with friends. The service and food were excellent.  Can’t wait to dine again soon.
Quaint setting in pretty courtyard. Service was excellent. Waiter made good recommendations; food was excellent.
Great food and service

We stayed at the Phoenician and went here for our anniversary dinner because it was all that was open. The food wasn’t BAD it just wasn’t that great. There wasn’t a ton of flavor, especially in the burger all I tasted was the meat. Presentation was great, service was great, and ambiance was great especially outside this time of year. Breakfast was MUCH better. Dinner was meh. Would go somewhere else for dinner next time.
beautiful view of resort, especially the palm trees!
My wife had the salmon and I had the rosemary chicken. Service was good. We ate out on patio. The dining experience was very good. They should serve bread though to dip in the juices and gravy
Very Covid safe. Great food and service.

We expected to have brunch or breakfast. The menu had breakfast items on it. But after we started to order “brunch” items 
we were told lunch only 
Almost every restaurant has brunch on Sunday. 
So we were very disappointed. The lunch food we had was very good but why show us a breakfast menu if we can’t order from it.

Service was great, our server did the best she could to accommodate us. Atmosphere was odd, cool decor, but very bright. Definitely felt like a "hotel restaurant," we are not likely to return. So many great options in Phoenix/Scottsdale, this is not one. Food was fair, not real inspiring.
Celebrated my husband’s birthday here with a table overlooking the gorgeous pools at night. The setting was as fantastic as the food!! We definitely will be back.
Because the highly acclaimed steakhouse at The Phoenician is closed because of the pandemic, Mowry  not terrible. Try for a table on the veranda for a great view of the pool and mountains.

Dora and Britney were excellent and so friendly thanks for a great experience we will be back.
Toddand Kylie

My kids and I are staying at the Phoenician and we love this restaurant! Our server, Christine was absolutely awesome! She was so accommodating and yet solicit ll you distanced. We truly enjoyed our time with we and learned about her life while she inquired about ours! We would come back again...just for her (but the food is fabulously fresh and locally sourced)!

I wish I could say this was good but not even close. This is a LARGE resort that according to staff is more than 90% full this weekend yet they only have this one restaurant open and service and wait time and food quality has been well below average. They really should have increased staffing for food and beverage. We are at Canyon Suites, the Five Star area of Resort and it is sorely lacking what other lesser starred resorts have managed to do and provide during these challenging times.
We arrived at 11:30am and were asked if we would like to order off the breakfast or lunch menu. Very accommodating. Must try the eggs Benedict!
Fabulous waitress!! Food was sooo good. I’m vegan and the chef was able to whip up an amazing dish for me. Highly recommend!!

Disappointing dinner experience at Mowry and Cotton! Dish arrived with cold, chewy chicken. Salad was the most bland, uninteresting, and very small for the price. Specifically requested certain ingredient not be included in dish and it was. Steak ordered medium rare arrived well done. Just locals who thought they’d try the restaurant but won’t return.

Too cold outside to have misting system on.  Portions of pasta were small and the pesto was over salted.  The drinks were not what we expected.  Too sweet.  Overall, it was Applebees food with resort prices.

The food was very good -- clever sauces and nice use of varied ingredients.  

Service was adequate.  Our waiter was friendly and attentive and gave helpful advice about the menu.  But he forgot to put the lime in the seltzer when requested, then forgot AGAIN when we asked a second time.  He brought it the third time.  Also, him saying "wow, I can't believe you ate all that food" really didn't suit too well with my date.

The ambience will never be great at the patio above the pool, but it could be ok.  The evening we went they had the misters running even though it was too cool, making us cold. We didn't want to move inside due to Covid.   The wait staff apologized but said they learned the night before tha they couldn't turn the misters off during dinner because they would drip.  Let's hope the restaurant has learned to turn them off an hour before dinner.

Overall, we enjoyed it enough to go back.

Dora was very professional and courteous, as well as the backwaiters and other staff. We were sat without an issue, which nowadays isn’t typical... even with a reservation, at most places, there always seems to be some excuse to make you stand and wait, but that was not the case here. It was a hot night, but the misters were on in the patio. We had a great night and Dora even brought us each a complimentary glass of champagne as we were celebrating our anniversary. We finished the champagne upstairs on the balcony overlooking the pool. It was a great overall experience.
Dinner for 2. Reservations @ 6pm. Veal meatballs were great. Salad with pheasant was very good. Good IPA draft. Prickly pear mimosas for my wife that she enjoyed.
We sat outside for lunch as they had misters. Service was top notch. The fries were some of the best! We are locals and thought this would be too touristy but we will return!

Great location. The patio lights were a bit on the bright side and it was a tad noisy. That said, there was a rather large group behind us which probably added to the noise. The food was good, a bit too salty for my liking. The service was cheerful and polite. We will give it another try once we have tried every outdoor venue locally.
We had a wonderful time! The food and service was exceptional! Look forward to going again soon!
Beautiful restaurant with amazing service! Will definitely be returning
Great food and cocktails!

The kitchen was very slow. Dinner took 3 hrs and the food was cold when it finally came. The server was very apologetic and accommodating. We ate outside and it was lovely and quiet. We did not mind waiting between courses because we had friends to chat with.

Service was slow with server avoiding the table until food arrived. My flatbread appetizer was cold of which I informed my server. Our main course took a while to arrive and my dish was cold again. Manager did give me some credit on my bill.

Very disappointing on all fronts.  Requested table outside on reservation.  Hostess started to seat us inside.  I pointed out the 8 empty tables outside and reminded her that we requested outside.  She said they were fully booked and seated us inside.  I watched and those tables never turned.  

The seats at the table were uncomfortably low, especially the bench.  The interior decorator obviously never sat in them.

Service was slow, inattentive, and intermittent.  Except for the servers who interrupted us twice to try to give someone else's food.

Wine list was OK, but nothing special.  

Menu was limited.

My ribeye was nothing better than I could have ordered at Texas Roadhouse.

With so many outstanding restaurant choices in the Phoenix and Scottsdale area, and with little that went right on this visit, I cannot see a reason I would return here.

We went for AZ Restaurant week.  We had the crispy calamari which was delicious.  i had the prawns and pasta which was excellent, my husband had the hanger steak.  The dessert was lemon pie and it was just the right amount of sweet and tart.

We sat outside and the misters were nice to cool down the heat, but the lighting was very bright and harsh for a nice evening dinner. The server was very rushed and seemed impatient. The food was ok but not great. I had a pasta with prawns and it only came with three. Pretty skimpy for the price. Will not go back again.
Beautiful view of the pool with outside seating. Service was outstanding, food was excellent. All around perfect meal.
Everything was good except the food.  It was just so so.  Very disappointed in the quality of the food.  We love the are but we will not go back to dine.
Food was amazing , service and ambiance

We arrived a few mins late (8:16pm) due to our uber cancelling on us and having to re-order. We apologized when we got to the restaurant and understood if they were not able to seat us. The hostess was very polite and sat us right away. Our server on the other hand, was rushing us the entire time and was annoyed when we ordered two appetizers and a salad to share. Keep in mind we each had two drinks and the placed closed at 9pm so she made a decent tip.

This restaurant is adjacent to the large pool area and is quite casual.  We were disappointed at the view from the patio and the background music.  Servers wore jeans & forgot to bring us silverware as appropriate.  Food was good but nothing was exceptional.  The heirloom salad was beautiful and the sauce was very good.  I love tomatoes but even for me it was too many tomatoes and it needed to be paired with something other than 2 lettuce leaves and a miniscule sprinkle of bacon shreds.  My hangar steak was good but again, only served with mushrooms and it desperately needed a starch or additional vegetable of some kind.  My lemon dessert was a simple piece of lemon pie with 3 tiny meringues on top.  We visited because it was Restaurant Week, but we won't return.
We were there for Restaurant Week.  Service was great, even though we had newer employees.  Food was delicious.  We sat outside, which was very pleasant with the misters.

The foods was pretty ordinary.... pickled blueberries ? what were you thinking they were horrible and did nothing to enhance any flavor on the plate
When ordering a steak I expect to cut it myself I hate when my steak turns up cold due to the chef checking to see if they actually cooked it correctly ! 
The salmon was over cooked and dry again the flavors on the plate were poorly conceptualized. The pasta looked fine.
The speed in which the meal was delivered was odd plates were removed before all at the table had finished their course and the next course delivered over the top of the first one I was still eating my appetizer when the entree arrived and was placed in front of me. 
We felt we were being rushed by staff. I had been really looking forward to dining here and was very underwhelmed by the actual experience I would not recommend Mowry & Cotton....

We spent the day and night at this beautiful resort. When we arrived excited about our meal (which was incredible). Our server Dora have us little attention. The severs surroundings us all explained the menu, chef and gave great recommendations. Our sever was essentially and order taker. She took our orders and that was it. If this was an Applebee’s I would understand. But..when you spend $150 on dinner you expect a little effort ESPECIALLY when all the tiger tables were getting outstanding service. I’m not one to write reviews but felt the need to air this out. Literally everything was amazing except our server! The hostess was kind enough to give us a table with a great view and went above and beyond to make us comfortable. My suggestion, move Dora to the snack shop.
Great experience.  Food was outstanding and restaurant tables/seating were consistently being cleaned.
Outstanding as always! Great ambiance, great food and service.
Nice ambiance good food great service but slow

I am not sure if our overall poor experience at Mowry & Cotton was simply a bad night or something more typical and I am only doing this review because I was prompted to.   It took 25 minutes from the time we were seated (with a reservation) until someone (other than the person who brought us water) even looked at us.   We raised our hands and finally caught the attention of a server who came to the table next to us (who were seated 15 minutes after us) to start taking their drink orders.  [On this server's behalf, she was very apologetic and took our orders right away.  Her name was Dora and we could tell she was working very hard to compensate for all of the disconnect.  She was professional, calm and very pleasant and I don't want any of this review to reflect on her other than to note that she tried her best to make everything right.]  

We ordered the lamp chops medium rare and they came out VERY rare- still cold and bloody on the inside.  We sent them back to be cooked and they came out 15 minutes later the exact same.  Still way too rare.  We were told by the manager (who came over of her own accord- we did not request to speak to her) that both the front restaurant staff and kitchen staff were short handed.  Hopefully, this was a unique experience.  It's still not what I would expect from one of the signature Phoenician restaurants.  The restaurant did try and offer some freebies to make it right but, in the end, we just wanted to be done with the evening.

My friends and I booked a reservation to celebrate my birthday for 6 people this past Sunday evening. Unfortunately we had a terrible experience. Our server was very kind, however he was not trained on simple menu questions regarding quantity and ingredients in food and drinks. Our reservation was for 6:30, and we didn't receive our drinks until 7:15. Food took another hour I would estimate. And we observed many other tables in the restaurant were in the same situation without food. There seemed to be a major breakdown in terms of staffing and it turned into an embarrassing birthday celebration. When our food finally came several items (including entree's for two of us) were completely forgotten. At that point due to the length of time we'd been there and overall frustration we asked them to cancel the missing food items, finished our food and left defeated. I suspect it had something to do with re-opening after being closed for a while; however at this price point I would expect the restaurant to be fully staffed and trained up before filling the restaurant with customers again. Overall it was a very disappointing experience.
FOOD AND SERVICE WERE EXCELLENT.ALWAYS A GREAT SETTING
Wonderful as Usual turn!
Excellent service, very good food and a pleasant atmosphere!
Fair. Food was average. Service was good.
First time there. Enjoyed our dinner and would definitely return.
Definitely worth the trip! Had a very nice night with my beautiful wife!

Dirty water glasses to start. Bread appetizers was ok, nothing special.
Mixed green salad was good.  Chicken dish was good. Brussel sprouts ok, salty.
Had the donuts for dessert, I assumed they would be served warm, they were not. Dessert was sub par and not worth the money or calories. Service was slow considering how empty the restaurant was for a Saturday night.  We sat outside which was very nice. Great location and ambiance everything else average.
We were outside in the patio area on a beautiful day.   Service was outstanding.  Everyone at the Phoenician Resort and Mowry & Cotton did an excellent job.

We had a party of 4 adults and 3 children (plus a sleeping baby). The food was wonderful, the ambiance is upscale cozy, the service was perfect and the kids loved their items. The drinks were also great. This is not where you would bring your kids if they want to run around and scream. We were equipped with iPads and toys. We went twice while staying at the Phoenician. We will be back next time we are in Arizona.

Food was disappointing - seriously over salted duck was returned.  Salmon also salty.  While our sever was exceptional, the music was too loud and was inappropriate for the location.  Not what we were expecting from the Phoenician.
The pheasant is absolutely wonderful. Great to find game birds on a menu

Our friends from CO were in town so we decided to go to your restaurant for lunch. We have mixed reviews about the food—the Reuben was great as was the burger, but on one of the turkey sandwiches, the bread was burned black and on the other, my friend ordered it without tomatoes and the pesto on the side with gluten-free bread so when she got it,  they left off the tomato AND avocado and there was no pesto. Disappointing...Service was slower than it should have been, considering how few customers there were in the restaurant.

Our server Dora was amazing. Ordered Mussels, Pheasant soup and tomato & burrata salad. Mussels were small but tasty. Tomato salad was outstanding. Had to send the soup back as it was far too salty. All I could taste was salt. Nice vista by the pool. Quite a few kids and families...good experience overall.
Really great food and a beautiful locaton
Everyone from the valet to our final waiter, Marc....was perfect!!   First ...but not the last time we will spend the evening at The Phoenician!!!   Thanks!!

We were seated immediately at a quiet table as requested on open table Service was timely and courteous Food was very good and worth the relatively high price A very nice place for a special occasion and even though it is expensive the food and service were worth it. Highly recommend
Enjoyed it
Everything was good-nice, but waitress was pushy the entire evening w/many repeated visits to get our order, etc.
This ia a great place to unwind after a long day, has a great view, the staff is knowleadgable about the menu and work with any of your preferences. I would definitely recommend you check this out.
Staff was amazing. They made my parents anniversary so special.

We really enjoy eating here. The chef prepares his dishes with a different flare and the outdoor ambiance is enjoyable. So why the 3 star rating this time? Well it was the service! Throughout dinner we felt rushed. We enjoy a leisurely pace. The waitress kept asking what we would like for our main course while we were enjoying our appetizers and drinks. We purposely didn't order our full dinner knowing that Mowry and Cotton can push you out a bit too quickly. We noticed other tables were served their "next courses" before finishing the ones they were eating. So when you're enjoying your wonderful dinner at M & C just beware of your order timing.
Very slow service, although there were very few tables at the time. Food was delicious, but extraordinarily long wait for our drink and food to arrive.

Food was great! This is a fun place to take people who are from out of town because you get the resort feel. You also get to witness the bird handler with the hawk! This is to keep the small birds that are pests out of the way. I wasn't a huge fan of my waiter. He was a little too much and then seemed to be pre-occupied with other issues.
The setting, service and flavorful food was first rate.  This dinner was final evening of a great vacation ended in fine style.

We had a
Lovely lunch with friends from out of town!
The staff at the Phoenician are always happy and helpful. Always enjoy my dining experience!
Very good good. DJ played appropriate music for crowd, place, time. Seeing the hawk was cool.

We loved everything about this restaurant except for one thing: the DJ had her music volume so high we couldn't hear each other from one end of the table of six to another.  We asked the server to ask her to turn down the volume and she did, but not enough for us to really enjoy our conversation.  I don't understand why this happens so often... we don't come for a concert... we came for a meal and fellowship with friends.  Everything about this restaurant helped us achieve our goal of a great meal, but the music was just a detriment to our conversation.  If there is an either/or, I suggest getting rid of the music.  On a delightful note, there was a woman with a Harris Hawk on her arm to "discourage" birds from entering the dining area.  She was most interesting and friendly, being very free to talk to us about what she does and how she does it.  And, it was very effective.  Loved this!  I would go back again, hoping that there was no music.
Really nice! Service is fantastic! Sitting outside,  the view is lovely!!

Very spendy for what we received, I ordered the ribeye, medium rare- it came over done, Popeye’s has spicier chicken, and I would give them the benefit of the doubt and call it a bad day in the kitchen.

Great place for an eclectic choice of food. We enjoyed the Lamb tacos, pheasant soup, burrata salad, sea bass, salmon, scallops and the ribeye were expertly prepared and were delicious. Kid friendly options as well are available.
Large family dinner. Jacqueline provides amazing service.
Noise level is crazy, very small menu but the food is delicious.

I loved having lunch here with my daughter, cousin, and good friend. I'm a local and have been before. We have some lovely brief, salmon, fries, and flatbread but was very disappointed the phesant soup was not available. We had date cake and ice cream for dessert: delicious! Their coffee is also very good. Highly recommend, but I wish they had that phesant soup!

Serious disappointment.  Perhaps it was due to the holidays but you would expect the best at the Phoenician.  They opened a back room where they first seated us. Dirty carpet.  Dirt under the table got onto my hands and evening outfit.  We asked to be moved to the main dining room and finally long after our reservation we were seated and happily accepted a table in the bar area.  Preset holiday menus are always disappointing.  The difference was the service here was very nice.

We should have gone to Motel 6 to eat. The menu was "special for Christmas and it could not have been the worst most bizarre choices.  When I jokingly and politely told the server how poor the menu selection was he had no sense of humor and avoided us the entire lunch. Had to constantly ask others to help us... Since Host Hotels took over the Phoenician its has degraded. The lobby bar The Thirsty camel (where we had to retreat to to try and get some decent food) wasn't open until 2PM And this was Christmas Day. Then at 2PM on bar tender was assigned to the bar with a lobby full of guests. It was a fiasco.
Great food and service. Imaginative menu. Jacqueline was great!

Food was really good and atmosphere.  Waited quite a long time for dessert and then people hovering over us as we were the last ones. We sat by the door and they were opening cabinets and putting dishes/glasses away right behind us.  Thought they could have waited as that was loud.   Waiters ran right to clean table as soon as we left.
Great food and great service! Super clean and awesome server.

We went at 11:30 AM for an early lunch. Tasty food with delightful presentation, menu options superb, Mallory was knowledgeable, friendly, fast. The price was what we expected.  What wasn't expected was the Falconer to come to our table with a gorgeous Harris Hawk (we encouraged him to visit with us).
So we learned about what an amazing venue this is as well as about Harris Hawks (the latter is excellent for keeping birds away from outside diners).

Lovely, memorable, and tasty time!
Food was delicious. Had the chicken flatbread and it was fantastic. Server was very knowledgeable but not perfect, which is what you expect at the Phoenician.
Thanksgiving. Cold air coming through plastic curtain. We were our servers 1st afternoon seating. Room pretty empty. Service was pretty inattentive.
Extremely expensive, extremely good!

Nice Setting towards pool area.
Interesting Concept with plattest to Share, Creative Menue
Outstanding service by Kacqueline
Christine was FABULOUS for our large party. Thank you, Christine!

Service was weak, food took too long to come out and it was no longer hot by the time it did. Seemed like it had been sitting for awhile. Husband’s pheasant had a long hair in it. I had the chicken which did nothing for me. Friend had a steak, she also said she was underwhelmed. The food was disappointing for the price and the service was sub par. Would not return.

Overpriced and frankly mediocre food for what you pay. The famous bread buns where average at best, first batch served cold, second not much warmer. Not a bread snob at all, but these where below average.
Scallops are decent and almost cooked correct, slightly under cooked, but better than over cooked.
Steak was a measly portion although it was a good piece of meat. 

The potatoes where smothered with sauces, really need to tell diners so you can order on the side.
Never had potatoes served this way.

Slow service added to the so/ so experience. $140 with tip and only one beer, no desert, way overpriced for what you get. The view sitting outdoors is nice, but not exceptional.
Overall do not recommend
Outdoor lighting too bright but great after they turned it down.
The menu was limited. I thought brunch was have some breakfast and lunch options but the menu was very small. Service was a little slow.

A major disappointment. The food was terrible. The sea bass tasted like dirt, literally. The cauliflower and Brussels sprout sides were so salty, they were inedible. The meatballs were so dry and overcooked, they were among the worst meatballs I’ve ever eaten. Subway has better meatballs! 

Overall, this was the worst restaurants we’ve eaten at in a very long time. We will not be going back. In fact, if the food were free, we would not go back.

The service was also terrible. We waited 15 minutes for our bill to come and then another 15 minutes for someone to take it for processing. The food was delivered to our table and they had absolutely no idea who ordered what. 

AVOID THIS PLACE!!!!
Food was below average
Good food.  Extremely wonderful service!
Delicious dishes, made for sharing, paired with amazing cocktails in a picturesque setting!
Amazing! Loved everything especially the squash flatbread.

We had the Whole Sea Bass - a signature dish (for two).   It was delicious; however the experience was marred a little.   When the fish arrived, a small platter with lime creme fresh and five tiny tortillas was provided.   Naturally we starting making little tacos and the five tortillas were gone in no time.

It took quite some time before we were able to get additional tortillas.  During that time, we waited awkwardly, staring at the fish.

The presentation needs to be re-imagined.  Either increase the size of the tortillas, or bring more up front.

Jackie and Dora are amazing. Jackie navigated the menu with us and we went with all her suggestions. The lamb tacos were delicious, the pork and the hanger steak were to die for but the sides were even better than the main courses. The sliced crispy potatoes were unbelievable. We can’t wait to come back. Great job Ahmet, Dora and Jackie.
Service was super slow
We sat outside and the ambiance was relaxing ad romantic. The food was outstanding and more than we could eat. I would highly recommend this restaurant!

Mowry & Cotton was okay. It was a pleasant atmosphere, sitting out by the pool. The service was a little slow and the food was missing some flavor to wake it up. The pot de creme dessert was the best thing I had and it was delicious as were the whoopie pies my husband ordered. Bravo to the pastry chef!
Food was good. Great service. Loved the patio seating.

Went for Arizona restaurant week. Excellent food and nice menu but one of the only restaurants this week that did not include the drink with the $33 menu. The spinach salad was ok, not very innovative and slightly too wet . The salmon and roasted broccoli was delicious. The herb compote dessert was wonderfully done. However we did not find out until we got the bill that there was an $8 additional charge for the appetizer bread rolls which I found to really be “nickeling and diming” for restaurant week, as it is supposed to be an all inclusive menu, and it was just bread and butter. Seemed like a cheap way to get more money out of the customer. The service was sub par but in fairness we had a new waiter who seemed to be in training. Atmosphere was pleasant and relaxing overlooking the pool. Overall a great place but they could’ve done better for restaurant week .
Dora was the best!
We went for restaurant week and sat on the patio. Great food and good views.

Dinner is good. We love what we had for that night. We love the buttermilk bun and herb pot de cream very much. We ordered charred hanger steak and roasted salmon. I give 3 stars instead of 4 stars because it was my wife birthday . When i make the reservation, i did noted that it is for my wife birthday celebration. We are very disappointed that no one say happy birthday to her and her dessert plate has no happy birthday written on it. Our dinner didn't ended with what we expected.

We went there to celebrate my husband's birthday so we dressed accordingly, however the majority of other customers were very casual, ie, T-shirts, flip-flops, not what we were expecting from the Phoenician.  The food was okay, the menu pretty limited and service was lacking, again not what we expected from this resort restaurant-sadly lacking from previous restaurants here.  We will not be back.

Visited The Phoenician after a long time. Mowry &Cotton is housed in the same location where The Phoenician used to have their very upscale Weekend champagne brunch till the money losing proposition got too expensive.
The much shortened menu of the casual Mowry and Cotton restaurant was very good. The prices were a bargain, the food was good as the very best ingredients were used and the service was excellent. A shout out to Austen who took care of us. Also the fro-mosas were an excellent deal - 3 for $18.  Throughly enjoyed the 2 1/2 hrs we spent there. Definitely will do a repeat visit next month!
Big group. The food and ambiance was phenomenal. The music was a little loud for Saturday lunch. The service was a little sparse. Overall a great experience.
Amazing meal from start to finish, excellent service, food and wine.
Anniversary

The Phoenician really knows how to do service right, from the moment you drive up.  They making knowing and using your name a priority.  Our server, Samantha, was delightful, friendly but not overbearing, attentive but not hovering.  The food was perfect, with the lamb tacos being a standout, not to mention the buttermilk buns.  The hanger steak and grilled shrimp were delicious.  Samantha even comped our desserts since it was our anniversary.  It was a really lovely and memorable evening.
Excellent Pheasant. Service was very attentive. We highly reccomend the restaurant.

We sat at our table over 45 mins before we had our starter/appetizer. The writer did not smile or refill our waters. Our food was prepared incorrectly with the second courses and entres’s.  We were not compensated for their several mistakes and lack of service at our table. The restaurant wasn’t busy but they were too busy to give quality service and prepare our food correctly. I would not recommend this place if you are anticipating quality service.

Super impressed with the quality of the food. It was very quiet for a Tuesday night, very few people there. Service was here and there, likely busy prepping for a busier time. They were courteous and knowledgeable.
This was my 4th visit and I was met with the same quality of service and food that has kept me coming back.
Our third visit.  Menu is always varied and interesting.  The service level is commensurate with the property and always excellent.
The food was amazing and our server was friendly and very helpful with explaining the menu items.

I am not impressed, this was my second time to give the restaurant a chance. Service was good but the meal was mediocre. Probably will not be back. Drinks on the happy hour menu were very sweet and had very little alcohol.
Fabulous food with an incredible wait staff!! Every single time!!!
Made our birthday celebration special ! Great restaurant !
a great place to get a snack and a drink.  Great quality food, and they have summer specials/happy hour all day.  4 drinks, 2 flatbreads, and we were out the door for $50 bucks.

The food is amazing! Staff very pleasant. Service overall is slow, yet the food is so good you will come back. 
We've been 5 times in 4 days. Like I mentioned the staff are very nice. Our server this morning at breakfast was our shining star, Christian is amazing! On top of things, clearly stands out from the other servers we've had. He should help out with training as he knows what he is doing. Thank you Christian!
Very pleasant surprise, great food, great service and a very relaxed atmosphere at a great price
Great food but the real star of the restaurant was the service by our waitress and staff never let our water run empty and who gave us great recommendation.
Food and service were very good!
Great date night
The Phonecian used to be a “special” place for dinner.  ...just didn’t seem that way this time.  The service was ridiculously slow and staff seemed sloppy and not very attentive.
Great job as always
Service and food was outstanding and creative. Ask for Samantha she was great!!!

Weird experience. Brown lettuce in our salad. Sea bass listed as shareable portion was very small. Then our waiter and busboy seemed to quit in the middle of dinner. We had to flag down another server to finish with our meal. We never saw our server again and when we went to speak to someone at the host stand, no one was there either. Expect better from the Phoenician.

Much better experience than we expected.  The beets appetizer was excellent.  The halibut was ok.  The wine list is very expensive and prices were 3 or 4 times retail.  We enjoyed the experience but avoid resort dining because the prices are not in line with other non resort restaurants.  Living in Phoenix full time and hoping some resorts start gearing themselves more for locals.

Mowry and Cotton is getting to be one of our favorite "go to" restaurants in The Valley! This time we enjoyed eating on the terrace, it was beautiful The service is superb and the dinner choices are a bit different than most restaurants but really delicious. My wife had the hanger steak and I had the halibut for our entrees. For appetizers we shared the charred beets and also the tomatoes and burrata. This is a must try if you haven't been there yet!

My husband and I dined here for restaurant week, and we are glad we did! I had the heirloom tomato salad and my husband had the charred beets, and both were excellent - great flavors in both. I had the halibut for my main course and it was oh so very excellent - not dry and seasoned just right. My husband had the hanger steak and he said it, too, was terrific - not dry at all and also seasoned perfectly. We finished our meal with deserts: I had the whoopie pies and they were very good. My husband had the lemon meringue, and he said it was also very good. It was a great experience and I highly recommend Mowry and Cotton!

My 55th Birthday was amazing here... 
Our AZ Restaurant Week choice!

Me and my friend were there for Restaurant Week and from the absolutely amazing service, (our server was so good for us) the relaxed & luxurious ambiance, to the presentation of the food and of course the smells and taste was so unbelievably out of this world! I chose this restaurant because the food combinations are so creative that when I saw this I knew I had to try it! And I’m so glad I did! The Chef is truly talented, I’m a home cook, so I really appreciated how everything was curated to perfection! Definitely coming back here again!

Four of us tried this for Arizona Restaurant Week. Beautiful setting and the weather cooperated so that we could dine on the patio. First, there were two spots of bird droppings on the wood table and no placemats. We asked that they be cleaned off. 
When our appetizers arrived, the wait staff had to ask each one of us who had what, so they knew where to place them! They were very ordinary, and when the staff took our plates, they put our used fork and knife back on the table to be used again.  We were expecting clean utensils, but no, they wanted us to use the same ones. Remember, the table wasn't too clean to begin with! 
We all had the same entree, Halibut with a peri peri sauce and vegetables. The fish was cooked perfectly, but so salty, we all complained. Some of us ate very little.
Dessert was not good at all. We tried the whoopee pies and lemon meringue pie. Of the two, the lemon pie was best. The whoopee pies were stale tasting.
This could be a lovely dining destination if some training were done for the wait staff. Besides the food being below standards for a top resort, we had to worry about asking for new utensils, more iced tea and directing our food to the correct diner. Very disappointed. Nothing was removed from our bill for the salty fish but a glass of champagne was brought out at the end of our meal, gratis. Not enough of a gesture.

We started off with a great cocktail
At the main bar and Mandy was terrific. 
Once we got to the restaurant all went downhill. Our server was adequate and considering that the dining room was nearly empty this was a surprise.  The menu sounded great for restaurant week but the food was tasteless.  We were not even finished with our salads and the main dishes arrived. We had to ask the young lady to remove the plates before she set everything down on top of us.
The whoopie pies we’re stale and had no taste. The lemon pie was far better.

Overall a very disappointing first experience at the Phoenician and one we will not repeat. We had invited friends and it was embarrassing

We were seated in an area where the one server was the bartender. It was clear she had too many duties to be an effective server. Sadly, the long waits between her appearances seriously took away from our experience. An earlier visit to this restaurant was far superior.

We were a party of 8. At our request, our table was in front of the open prep station. The breads and fabulous shishito Peper’s are a MUST for this restaurant. We were all happy with our mains. Great food, attentive service and reasonable prices
Wonderful dining experience restaurant week menu was great.

This is an incredibly beautiful restaurant with awesome views. The staff was very friendly and down-to-earth. The food was great and we went for Arizona restaurant week so the price was pretty good. They raised the prices of their cocktails, so those are quite a bit pricey. But delicious, as everything was that we had. We had the halibut and it was just awesome.
Even though the food here is very ,very good, the service is horrific!  Why dine in a luxurious hotel restaurant when the service is abominably bad!

AMAZING!! The buns are a memory I won't forget for a long time. It is a beautiful restaurant, sitting on the patio during sunset is blissful.  The cocktails are unique and fancy - exactly what you are looking for when going to fine dining.

We dined here during restaurant week.  The PF menu was $33; excellent value.  Outside seating with view of pool.  Apps and desserts were great; entree of hanger steak tough and disappointing.  We would return.
Christian was a great server! Good Food and ambiance.
great, always is!
The service was outstanding, the meal was exceptional, and the ambiance spectacular ... truly, a perfect venue to celebrate Mother's Day 2019.
Outstanding dinning experience. Great selection of food. In fact food was had amazing taste and was fresh - salomon and eggs-benedict.  Staff was very hospitable and responsive.  Highly recommend.

The service was dismal.  It was as if the servers did not show up and the food runners took over. Had to continually ask for refills, not one dish was delivered to correct person. No explanation when small salad was dropped and run smack in front of my husband who ordered the mommas  Benedict. Food was outstanding!
Can not begin to RAVE about our dinner at Mowry & Cotton.  The staff was amazing particularly Andrew.  The food out of this world - absolutely loved the evening and experience.  Highly Recommend .

Service was very disappointing.  Little attention given to plate removal and providing new silverware after course finished.
Food was good, but service was lacking.
Even though we are long-time AZ residents it always makes you feel like you're on vacation when you visit a resort like the Phoenician.
Graduation dinner
Food and ambiance was great, but the drinks took a lonnng time and our server had trouble with orders and splitting up the ticket.
Relaxing place for Sunday brunch. There are beautiful views overlooking Scottsdale.
good food and great service.always good dining experience
Great food, service and wine selection.  Elouan Pinot Noir & Madness & Cures Red Blend huge hits..
Easter Brunch. So fun and food was delicious.

Good location in a beautiful resort setting. Have been numerous times. This Saturday at lunch the addition of a DJ blasting music was undesireable and forced us inside the restaurant where we still heard more music that we like. The issue was the music volume prevented any conversation.
Everything was delicious and service was on point!
Celebrated a friends birthday on the patio great ambience. Service was great enjoyed it I  would definitely  go again!
Artichoke was not edible. Pheasant and potatoes were so-so. I’d recommend it for lunch but not enough value for dinner.

This was our second time to Mowry & Cotton. The view is great as is the ambiance. Unfortunately, both of our steaks were improperly cooked. We returned my steak (which was supposed to be medium but was initially served rare) and it came back well done. The waitress was nice enough to take off one of the steaks but both were inedible. The sides were good and she did bring us a dessert on the house. We waited 17 minutes for the valet to bring our car, so we were home late for the babysitter. Not a great anniversary night but there will be others.

Mowry and Cotton was extremely disappointing in one important regard.
The fella who stepped in for the gal at the bar...poured a ridiculous unfair cocktail.
They are pricey and he made no effort. ..the gal was reasonable.
The appetizers were very good, as well as the veggies and entrees.
cannot recommend if one wants to relax and have a drink or two.
Service was really good, food was above average but priced at resort pricing
Ornery server. Many mistakes. Sad experience as we used to have nice times here. Beautiful very expensive hotel. Unfortunate their on property dining is struggling.

We waited an hour for our food so I was expecting it to be extra delicious and I was sorely disappointed. My shrimp was dry, the Caesar salad needed more dressing and the potatoes were greasy. It just wasn’t a good experience especially at that price.

Food delicious. Server pleasant. But such an extreme amount of mistakes. Orders not put in, orders made incorrectly, Total disaster making each of our party basically eating separately and kids near melt down state by the time all food came. Terrible when you are relying i. this restaurant as the main mid-level dining at a high end resort.
Great food and ambience. Will definitely go back.
Food was exceptionally good. Loved it!!
We had a nice time. The restaurant has been remodeled and looks good.
good service,good food and great setting at the Phoenician
This was a wonderful restaurant incredibly good service and we got to sit out by the pool. Great grilled food.

Amazing even epic experience, nothing short of brilliant. Christine is a goddess among servers, uncanny in her ability to perfect the smallest details. She definitely made our brunch enjoyable, leisurely, relaxing and luxurious. Now THAT is what brunches are meant to be, thanks to the Phoenician for a memorable day!

Samantha was probably the best server that I have ever had!!!! I am 66 years old and have traveled around the world and have eaten at various restaurants. She was very attentive,extremely helpful, and her personality was a 10+. She is truly an asset to any company she will ever have the privilege to call her place of residency.
Jacqueline is an incredible hostess. We come back for her amazing service.
Food less than expected for a resort of this repute.

Food was consistently well-prepared and artfully presented. All staff were at all times , courteous, professional, and attentive to all of our needs and requests. We will be sure to eat here again when we are back in Arizona on vacation. Keep up the great work !!
We miss Il Terrazzo! It was so peaceful for dining.

Every bite was excellent. Be warned that each dish is big, so unless you have 4 or more people in your party it will be easy to over order. None of what we ordered was an appetizer size. Even the soup was a huge portion. All the staff were friendly and helpful. The weather dictated that we needed to eat inside but the room was beautiful. We would love to go back and eat outside sometime.

I was surprised at how many families with small children were having dinner here. Between the high ceilings, concrete floors, loud music coming from the speakers, and the noise from the kids, the atmosphere was too noisy and anything but relaxing.  The highlight was the wait staff, who were attentive and polite.  The lamb tacos were unique though a little on the greasy side.  The chop salad was made of arugula, although that was not mentioned in the description.  My partner had the burger, and it was cooked medium rare, just like he ordered it.  He said the burger was very good, and he chose a side salad which he said was also very good. I suppose if one could sit outside on the patio, the noise level would be much better, and the views might make for a more relaxing dinner.
Great food. Not enough staff but the staff they had was wonderful. Lots of families so the commotion factor is there. A little pricey

The whole fish-sea bass was absolutely fantastic. It was a very large portion that could be shared by 2 people. The pheasant was rather dried.  Outside tables and atmosphere were nice but the seats could use a little cleaning.
It’s nice, but not special or outstanding, it’s pretty pricey and at that cost, should be better. For the price you can have much better experiences in the area.

When we arrived, we chose to have a drink in the lounge while waiting to be seated. We were practically ignored. I had to seek service and they were not busy at the time. The service was very slow and the food was very sub par especially for a grand resort. I certainly expected more. I cannot recommend this restaurant to anyone. Over priced, under quality.
The restaurant was very good but it was at a Marriott Resort which made it very hard to get to with a long walk from parking to restaurant.
We had a late meal at Mowry & Cotton and thoroughly enjoyed the food and ambience.

We looked forward to brunch/lunch here as locals.  Our server, Christian, was fabulous.  Unfortunately, the burgers we ordered were not.  The burgers had no flavor and I ordered medium rare while my husband likes his well done.  The burgers appear to have been mixed up but it was hard to tell because both of them looked like medium.  They had no flavor or seasoning, as previously noted.  The french fries that were ordered were dry inside and had a hard crust externally.  The best part of the order was the spicy potato  chips.  
Would not do this again; local burger joints do better.  We expected better from The Phoenician as a major resort here in Phoenix.

Our steak & bass were good.  Our server was knowledgeable and friendly.  Our only complaint was about the bread.  Most mid-level (not crazy expensive/not cheap) restaurants will bring you some bread while waiting for your meal.  We asked for some bread and were told it would be $8.  No problem... we are fine fine paying $8 for a nice bread basket.  What showed up was 2 pieces of toast.  Literally, 2 pieces of toast.  So, it’s not the biggest deal and like I said, we enjoyed our meal, but it was annoying to have to pay $8 for that.
The peppers were fantastic!  Generous portions. Excellent food all around!

We had an 8:30 reservation ,  arrived at 8:10 and we  waited at the bar.   We kept drinking and  ordering bar snacks and waiting at the bar while those who arrived  later than us, two separate parties,  were seated before us.  We know because we know them!  This was an industry meeting at the hotel!   We kept asking our hostess about our table and she kept saying  we were “ in the computer”!   Finally after I made a huge scene which is not something I like to do at all,  we were seated!   Service was extremely SLOW.  Shame because the food was very good,  after such horrendous service we never got an apology from the  manager.  It was bizarre.

We wanted to end our extended weekend in Scottsdale on a high note and brunch at Mowry & Cotton was absolutely perfect.
The hotel was designed to maximize exposure to the sun and we took full advantage; we soaked up the sun from our perch overlooking The Phonecian’s pools and very well manicured grounds.
The food? Amazing!  Yes, as others have mentioned, we started with the Monkey Bread and the Crispy Potatoes. Delicious! I loved the green chili pork shank. The meat was cooked to perfection and slid right off the bone. The salsa included two perfectly cooked sunny side up eggs. Her Avocado Benedict was rich and flavorful. What we didn’t realize was just how generous the portions are. 
We didn’t come close to finishing our plates. Next time, and there WILL be a next time, we will regretfully have to order fewer items.
All in all a fantastic way to end our stay in Scottsdale.
Average at best.  Typical hotel deal.

Celebrated hubby’s 60th bday at the Phonecian with dinner at Mowry & Cotton. Due to the holidays, the resort was overrun with families and children. They were kind enough to accommodate my request that we not sit near large groups with unruly children and there were many unruly children. Sadly its the new generations that are to blame for raising these beastly children. It really makes fine dining difficult. Having said that M&C did all that they could to make my husband’s bday enjoyable. The food was excellent! Thank you M&C!

We were told that kids under 3 ate free and that is not really the case. Were charged full price for kids meals.
Brunch service was very slow.

Nice menu and food is delicious.  Food is always served fresh and well prepared which is all anyone can ask for. Service can be hit or miss depending on kitchen and wait staff organization.  We have had breakfast and lunch here during our stay. The menu offers some nice choices. Great Benedict’s, chorizo egg tacos, and huevos rancheros. Outdoor dining is nice enclosed and heated area, but can get cold during mornings.
Perfect place for a date!

First let me say that we were staying at the hotel so had breakfast at this restaurant every morning and breakfast was great! Since most restaurants were closed on Christmas we decided to try Mowry for dinner that night. We were told that they were having a special Pre-fix Christmas dinner. I had assumed the restaurant would be decorated festively and so we dressed up, expecting a lovely dinner. It was Quite the opposite. Our waitress presented the menu and then told us that we could have the Christmas dinner ONLY if everyone orders it. Well, two of my adult children are vegetarian so they did not want that menu, therefore no one could have it. Then 3 people ordered short ribs and 15 min later we were told they were out of short ribs. They then ordered steak and other dishes. In a nutshell...the steak arrived raw and was not edible even after re-cooking. Other things were terrible and returned, including two of the salads. Would NEVER go back!! Totally ruined what should have been a beautiful evening.
Food one small step above Denny's.  Lovely hotel, restaurant seemed like and was where you would go for breakfast in a hotel.
Christmas eve dinner with family
Everything was wonderful! Service was very friendly, food was excellent, drinks fantastic. We will be back!
Fabulous time- food, service, ambiance by the fire!
Great food, great service, wonderful setting
Lack of service, first tim

Our first time.  A good experience but I'll offer some constructive feedback from our party of four.  We sat inside but if we'd known how great a dining patio they had we'd have sat outside; next time.  Efficient server.  Food was rushed out a bit after ordering to get us in front of a very large party.  Food was very good, all around the table. Here's our most significant comment:  The sides were touted by the server as being ideal to share, we ordered several.  There were NO spoons or other serving utensils that came with each side.   Always, but  especially during cold and flu season why would you expect each dinner to use their own spoon or fork to serve themselves.  We asked for spoons and got them.  Such a simple thing to send out something from the get go with each side.  This has happened at other even more pricey restaurants too.  We don't get it.  So solid service, excellent good and a pretty restaurant.  We will return.

The food was good, nothing that we ordered was particularly outsatanding, but the value was outstanding! 
The serving staff could use more training because the ice tea and water were not filled without asking. And knowledge of the menu was not strong. 
Overall experience was very nice!
We had a wonderful dinner. Our server Jaquline was outstanding!

Went there for a birthday brunch, told them in advance but was not acknowledged. I know they do strawberries for birthdays but didn’t get that. Service was very slow. Took 20 minutes to get coffee and creamer was old. Ordered blood orange mimosa but got something else. It took another 20 minutes to get the right one. Food was ok, nothing special. Had burger and chorizo tacos. No manager around. There is a DJ, she was playing really nice music and it wasn’t loud. She’s the only good thing about the restaurant. I love the Phoenician but I don’t think I’ll go back for brunch. I’ll stick to the steakhouse and high tea. Very disappointed

The restaurant was understaffed, and the hotel was at full occupancy. The food was mediocre at best. When asking the bartender to make a virgin spicy cocktail, the waitress came back to inform us they were making a virgin Bloody Mary...so not the best bartender either.
Excellent food. Wonderful service. Creative menu. Loved the breakfast every day. Enjoyed my small plates dinner, especially the lamb tacos. Very fresh food. Very personal service.

Had a fabulous experience at the Mowry and Cotton celebrating my birthday with some friends. The food was amazing, ambiance was great and service was also very good. Will definitely be coming back soon!
Server literally brought 3 appetizers and entrees within 5 minutes of each other. Terrible experience.
We very much enjoyed the Patio Anniversary Brunch on our anniversary.  Special treatment, great food and our server, Christine, was wonderful!

Competing music: pool v event
Entrees brought out cool
Tuna not seasoned and tasted bland.
Cocktails really good, bread and desert were delicious.
Very good and would definitely go back.
Awful service. Below average food. Overpriced. The Phoenician used to be a destination.  Now, sadly it is past its prime.
An absolutely fabulous meal and a very attentive staff!!!! Great experience all around!!!! Can’t wait to return!!!!

We went to Mowry and Cotton during restaurant week to celebrate one of my niece's birthday. The place is beautiful and service was very good.  We had the squash flatbread, chopped salad, salmon, steak, and desserts. All very tasty. Will come back for brunch sometime.
We went for the restaurant week special for girls night out and it was amazing! We had an excellent time and will definitely come back!
This was a restaurant week tryout and it was a very pleasant surprise! Great food and service!
The restaurant was wonderful!   Food delicious!  Ambiance great!  The only problem was getting there.  We got lost and finally had to ask someone the way.

The food menu was limited and flavor components were strange at best. Still, we decided to order many things to get a wide variety of sampling. Everything we ordered was dry, lacked complexity and balance of flavor, and was poorly produced. Brussel sprouts were served soggy in soy sauce, potatoes were super dry and had very small dry pieces of meat that were barely flavorful, lamb tacos were just stuffed with meat and nothing else and lacked good flavor. All in all we paid $130 for a very crappy experience. We will not be back.

We were there for the birthday celebration. 

The only downside on that evening is we need to wait for menu to come after seated ( we were there quite early 5:45pm, so is not busy ) and the waiter not even bring the restaurant’s week menu for us . We got to ask for that menu.  ( minus one star) 

Overall, we love the food there. Excellent food! Service for dinner is good. We had great times there. 

We will be back!

Went there  for restaurant week fall 2018.  Overall food was good.  Less a star because my pheasant had broccoli which tasted and looked past expiration.  My husband was able to substitute lamb loin for his steak which was nice.
Food mediocre at best. took forever to get the main course.

We enjoyed the ambiance and the food. We were disappointed that we were rushed through our dinner. We didn’t realize that the kitchen would be closing before 9:00 (closing time) and were pushed to order at 8:15.
Here on vacation. Food and service was outstanding!
The staff, from valet parking to doorman to guest services to waiters were very friendly and hospitable. They made you feel like they truly cared about you. The food was excellent also.

The space is beautiful, our server was very good.  But the food was subpar.  Even the cocktails were sub par.  And the meal was not inexpensive.  There are really GREAT restaurants on practically every single corner in Phoenix.  If Mowry & Cotton hopes to compete, they are going to have to seriously up their game.

Food was outstanding.  Service was poor.  We attended on a Saturday evening.  It took almost 30 minutes to obtain a menu other than the cocktail and wine menu.  When we asked for our bill at the end of the meeting, it took over twenty minutes to receive a bill.  Overall meal took over two hours.

When we attended, we were seated on the patio.  There was a children's party going on across the the property with a DJ that was very loud for the entire party.  The DJ was far louder than needed and even the servers commented that they had been unable to have the pool staff turn down the volume.  

Overall, it was a poor experience, despite outstanding food.

Frank

The first umpression: all wait staff dressed in good looking shirts and pants wearing leather aprons. The ambiente reminded me of a 1970 European style restaurant (a bit cold and noisy when it’s not full). But the service (the waiters, waitresses and bus personnel are marvelous) and the food make us come back another time. 
A must for starters: the chicken wings
And don’t leave without sharing the donut dessert
Excellent meal and service.
There weren't many people in the restaurant yet the service was quite spotty, and we had to attract a waiter's attention more than once to get things taken care of.

What a sleeper.  I expected a good hotel meal but this was a wow.  Innovative menu, great recipes, terrific service and ...large portions.  Only time I recall that i could not finish a steak.  The steak was superb.  Would go back anytime!  Far exceeded expectations.
Great time, cant wait to go back!

What a pleasant evening my friends and I had at Mowry and Cotton!  Delicious food, ample serving sizes, and a relaxing environment. We were commenting on all the reasons we will return again as we drove home. The sea bass was heavenly!

I was highly anticipating my dining experience at Mowry and Cotton after reading some great reviews about the chef and the food. You can never go wrong at the Phoenician for a great view. The service was outstanding. For this alone I can recommend dining here. 

The food however, was disappointing. We started with the artichoke flatbread. The texture was perfectly crisp, but the flavors were uninspired. We tried the green salad and the roasted cauliflower. Again the salad was average, but has fresh ingredients; so it was good, but not great. The cauliflower was roasted perfectly, nice and charred and firm to the bite. But again lacking in any "wow" flavor. The Chile peppers actually gave the dish the flavor pop it needed, but there were only two small slivers, leaving us wanting more flavor. Things took a much better turn with the entree. We had the whole bass which was served with flour tortillas and a cilantro cream sauce that was heavenly. The fish had a light, crispy coating and smoky roasted corn. I would definitely order this dish again and if you go, you should too. I cannot remember the exact name of the dessert, but it was 'smore themed and to die for! The dark chocolate melted under the fluffy toasted marshmallow top was sublime. 

So mixed reviews from this diner. I always have very high expectations of the food at a resort that is the caliber of the Phoenician. The restaurant is in a gorgeous location, top notch service, food is good but not outstanding. The prices were reasonable for a Scottsdale resort.
Amazing service.

The food was delicious, and my mocktail mojito had me feeling like I was on a beach in Mexico, but when I ordered a second one it never came. After 15 mins I was told the bar was busy, but that it would be right out. 10 mins later my check came and there was still no mojito, so we paid and left.
Pricey, confusing portion sizes & presentation of food, excellent service.
Casual but elegant

How in the world did the Phoenician get duped into letting this horrible - yes horrible restaurant onto the property?  From the days of Mary Elaine’s to the fabulous brunches and amazing tea service with Natalie and Wanda.  This new Mowry and Cotton is a disaster from the word go.  Cannot even begin to tell you how bad the three course deal was and it was uneatable.  Salad bitter - fruit dip had the viscosity of phlegm and you had to share with your table.  The Pork was as dry as the Sonoran desert and the whole table sharing is really uncomfortable because of the plates and presentation.  We never had such a below average or horrible experience as this New disaster.  I will wait for the next restaurant that takes its place.  Please make it worthy of the Phoenician!

Thank you
Lighting could be lower, felt a little cold in restaurant.  Food was decent not sure I’d be back anytime soon and nothing to rave about.

Birthday celebration was noted by staff and made experience extra special, great mixed drinks - super creative and good flavors on all dishes...pricey, but to be expected at this resort...worth a visit and return if it is your style.

I had high hopes for this place however most the food we had was mediocre at best. The dish my girlfriend had was a super over priced veggie plate with no flavor. The one thing we both liked was the bread.

We were very pleasantly surprised by how good this meal was. The buttermilk rolls were the best I've ever had and I would have been very happy just to eat those for dinner. I ordered the veal meatballs and they were wonderful and the roasted cauliflower side dish was exceptional even if you don't normally like cauliflower. The only things I could find to criticize if I had to were the music (just not my taste) and the lemon tart desert could have been better. But overall, I'll be going back for sure and the resort was fabulous!
Perfect place for brunch with friends
It's in the Phoenician.  That does not guarantee it will be good, but this restaurant is GREAT.  Our second visit.  Excellent food.  Service is outstanding, professional without being overly stuffy.

Beautiful ambiance, great food, superb service.  That being said, I didn't have a good time there.  The overall vibe isn't conducive to having a fun dinner.  Even though I live a stones throw from the Phoenician, I doubt that I will return to that restaurant.
Food was good, a little pricey but that's the Phoenician for you.
Our reservation was for 730 and we didn't leave until 930 . Our waiter never checked on us. We had to ask for a manager. We were not the only ones receiving crappy service

Waited and waited and waited for drinks and food.  People all around getting angrier and angrier.  Food wasn’t bad but waited 1.5 hrs for it.  Restaurant wasn’t that full. If we weren’t using travelzoo voucher, we would have walked out.  Don’t go.  Don’t go.  Don’t go.
Absolutely loved Mowry & Cotton — excellent service and delicious food !! Amazing ambience!!
Really good food and a great view. Will be back for sure.
Unique menu, quite delicious & excellent service. We went there for brunch. Recommend trying the shrimp & grits as well as the breakfast bruschetta (which has crab). Very generous portions.

The food quality was low. The service was horrible - we waited over 1 hour from completing our appetizers for our main course to arrive. The server was apologetic but also unavailable. Horrible experience. The only reason I give it even 2 stars is because the Phoenician is a beautiful place to drive up to. The restaurant is more like a "diner" type environment.

Dinner was delicious but what really made the mean was our delightful server, Jacquelin.  She obviously loved her job and beamed when describing the offerings.  Took her recommendations and were truly pleased.

Server did a good job, app was excellent.  Steak was poor(dry flavorless) side was also poor(half burnt other half under cooked)  Nothing special, hostess staff poor - issues like finger printes on glass, details not taken care.

The menu looks amazing and the flavors appear inventive. The execution is where the fall short. They put so much bonito flakes on the Brussels sprouts they were practically inedible.  The smoked spare ribs had fantastic flavor but the meet was tough and difficult to get off the bone.  The best salad had good components but the ratio to bbq sauce on the plate made it hard to taste the flavors of the beets. The salmon had good flavor but the edges of the fish were so thin and ended up overcooked. 
I will say, the cocktails were great. But not good enough to bring me back again.

Mowry & Cotton exceeded all our expectations.  The space, although crowded, works and once you are seated the noise level is fine. Tables are far apart.  Our server, Jackcaline , was simply marvelous despite the fact that I cannot spell her name.  She explained the menu, made suggestions and was most attentive.  The food was absolutely excellent.  From the mussels to the ribs, it was perfectly prepared and very tasty. We'll be back again.
The green chile pork shank should not be missed. I'm unsure what was up with the staff member with the falcon outside. That's something you don't see everyday.

Beautiful patio. Bottom line - the food just isn’t good and therefore it is overpriced.

It’s a a resort so the prices are expected but if you are going to charge $21 for a burger it better be cooked to temperature and actually good. Ordered it medium rare and it was well done. Fries were undercooked and over-salted. Spare ribs and wings were both dry and over-cooked. So basically - the food just sucks. 

However, I could certainly see grabbing a cheap $20 glass of wine and sitting on the patio at sunset. So if you are local - you know other places to go for dinner. If you are a tourist, coming from a local, go off campus for dinner and take your aperitif on the patio of Mowry & Cotton.

It was great and really enjoyed good service and food and what a beautiful place definitely going back. Sirnon was extremely helpful in explaining the choices and it was almost too good of service and we will have a hard time going back to normal restaurant. Excited to see the future of the hotel When construction is completed

Our party of 10 had a big communal table which was fun. Right in front of chef.  The 3for$30 was a good deal. Some confusion on their part from managers on phone to what waiters were saying in the restaurant about this deal. Food was very good and varied. Ordered 3 bottles of Perrier Jouet champagne but charged price was different from menu price. Something about system switchover creating errors. If I hadn’t caught it would have been $18 more/bottle. Our waitress was attentive and explained all very well. 

Good food and a fun venue for big groups at the communal tables.

Waiter was terrible.  He never checked upon us.  We had to ask the food runner (who was amazing) to get our waiter three times.  
Other then that the food, food runner and busser where incredible.

Service was good but it was very noisy making it a bit hard to converse.  We were seated at a table in the center of the room and the chairs were low and uncomfortable.  The food was mediocre.  The menu is limited and our selections, salmon and shrimp, were overly sauced.  The shrimp were small and over cooked.  The salmon was oily.  The flat bread starter was OK.  The “crispy potatoes” were not crispy and again, over sauced.  It was our second try at this place and we really wanted to like it but both times, the food was disappointing.  We most likely will never go back for dinner.  We might go back for drinks when we can sit outside.
The steak was tough and cold appetizer was very good.
The food was too fancy for me and I've had better steaks at Outback. I had a tuff Ribeye.
Our waitress was awesome and even acknowledged a birthday we were celebrating.

Our first time to visit this place and we were really impressed.Food was great,place was clean and cozy,server was attentive and friendly,dessert was fantastic.Definitely a place worth visiting again....

We chose Mowry & Cotton for our anniversary dinner, which coincided with a receipt of a Open Table $25 card.
