The waitress did not understand the concept of the gift card from Open Table and told us (not so discretely) that we could not use a coupon with their prix fix dinners.  We understand that combining offers is not usually acceptable and tried to explain that it was more like a gift card than a coupon.  She still didn't understand and got the manager involved, who also came to our table to explain why what we were trying to do was unacceptable.  He finally listened to what we were saying and actually looked at what we were presenting, then understood that the card worked like a credit card and could be easily applied to the bill.  Even though we were right, the whole situation left a bad impression with us.  
Open Table - please work with Mowry & Cotton so they understand the Open Table gift card process.
Mowry & Cotton - please listen to customers and look at what they are presenting PRIOR to assuming what they are attempting is wrong.  Also, be more discrete in the conversations.  Your restaurant is in an amazing and beautiful resort.
Food was disappointing.  Hubby ordered ribeye steak which was $$$ and tough.  I had salad and mussels which was just so-so.  Trevor, our server, did a very nice job.
As always amazing! Food is spectacular and service is great! Cameron is a rockstar!
The best in Phoenix.  Great service and food. New remodeled Phoenician is awesome

Overall it was a "fair" visit.  The service all around from our server to the back-server to management was all lacking in personal touch and attention to detail.  The $30 Summer Special was confusing on paper but once explained and ordered it ended up being a good deal. The meatballs were a favorite at our table favorite, followed by the ribs and the barbecued beets.  The mild weather and beautiful view made sitting out on the patio very pleasant.

arrived for 730 reservation at 730.  Hostess very frazeled even with half empty dinning room and patio.   was asked to sit down and wait in spite of  half empty.....    you order complete meal / apps......and food arrives plate by plate ...person by person... including one persons shrimp main course 30 minutes after everyone was finished with everything.

lighting was super bright .... music was on super low.... its  a PASS.
The Sous Chef is extremely talented. Our meal was superb. I ordered the 1/2 Pheasant and it was perfect. That is Not an easy dish to prepare well. A most enjoyable evening.

The service was outstanding, the food was good, but not good enough for five stars. Did I mention the service was outstanding!!!! One small suggestion, offer ice in your flat water....we are in the desert! Keep up the good work we will return.

The food was all very tasty. The restaurant says their menu is intended for sharing. If that is the case then the staff needs to be trained to accommodate that concept. When you have a party of four dining, the staff should automatically clear the center of the table. The staff should not be surprised that it is difficult to place multiple food items on the table. The service dishes should be purchased so that they can fit more amicably on the table simultaneously. If a staff member sees an empty shared plate, it should be removed immediately and not waiting until they are juggling with the next dish coming from the kitchen, so that the dining guests are compelled to move and hold the platter out of the way. If soup is served and placed in the middle with the expectation of it being shared, please don’t return with four spoons expecting us all to just dig in. When we asked for bowls, were told they didn’t have any. I immediately asked if we could have four of the small serving dishes they use for the spinach dip, since they didn’t have bowls. The waiter said he would ask. Someone came back after a few minutes with bowls. 
The food was all very good. If the service improved, we would definitely return, but otherwise there are so many good place in the valley that won’t make the top of our restaurant list.
The tuna bowl was incredible highly recommend   The flavors and appearance was fantastic!  We were here for business and ate here three days

Terrific. Every dish we had was beautifully presented and very tasty: charred tuna, wild mushroom flatbread and the short ribs. Each was a cut above the ordinary, with some great seasonings. Definitely worth a return trip, and the dining room was very uncrowded in the early summer season.
Great food. Nothin was bad. Definitely will be going back

The Phoenician has become just another Sheraton. It has lost all the luster of its glory days of the 1980's and 1990's.  Even with the renovation and construction going on, it couldn't be less glamorous or interesting.  The restaurant is a dining room like you would find in any other hotel.  Functional but uninspired.  Not worth a special trip. If you are staying at the hotel, it's convenient.  Otherwise, really don't bother.
I had to follow up and confirm my reservation.  They weren't busy and had a hawk lady.

Mowry & Cotton was beyond my expectations. Some of the best food I have ever had. The dishes are very unique, combining flavors in new ways. The Buttermilk Buns are a must! Absolutely amazing! My favorites of the night were the Crispy Potatoes, Spring onions, and Grilled shrimp. The Spring onions are something new and unexpected. Definitely recommend it! The Grilled Market Salad is also a must, just for the charred carrots that come in it! 

This was one of the best dining experiences I have ever had. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting the Phoenix area!
It’s nice to be at a resort where you can eat fine dining without leaving.
The food and service is unbelievable . Buttermilk buns, ribs Desert fabulous!
We had a great birthday lunch!! Our server was THE best!!! He did an excellent job!!

We are staying at the resort. The food was fair at best. The service was lacking. Our server was not very attentive, we had a long wait for food (even though it was not very crowded), and wrong food was delivered (after it was delivered to the wrong table). C’mon guys... just because it’s Monday shouldn’t mean we have to endure the C Team. There are many better restaurants a short Lyft ride away.

Absolutely amazing transformation for this resort space! Every detail taken into consideration in ambiance and menu. Creative dishes showcasing a chef that has a true passion for food as an art and well as satisfying your tastebuds. A foodie must in the Valley!

We enjoyed the top notch servers, fabulous new remodel, creative cuisine and outdoor seating. The only thing we could have done without was the rocking wedding party in another part of the resort, but within earshot.
Our first time at this restaurant in The Phoenician. Food was amazing. Our server was very knowledgeable and personable. We will definitely be back!
Beautiful venue with great food
Once again, a spectacular experience and the food was unbelievably.

This was surprisingly excellent. We had
The fried potatoes and they were stellar, crispy,  great sauce.  The bread had a chorizo and cheese dip, wow.  Cod nicely prepared and other nice fish.
Sat on the patio, beautiful evening with friends. Food was delish and service was great. We will be back

The food was spectacular.  We have several vegetarians in the family and the veg selections were incredible.  We ordered a plate of almost all of the options and served family style.  This dining experience was a real standout of our entire trip.

Samantha, our server was fantastic.  Prompt, answered all of our questions, make great recommendations.  

Certainly in the top of our experiences while in Scottsdale.
Early Mother’s Day

Mowry & Cotton has a creative menu to satisfy those that like to try something new. The whole sea bass savory was easy to peal away from its crusty skin, the grilled blackened cod was white and flakey. The mussels accompanied by white beans were in a light white sauce that made us grateful that the dish came with 4 toasts to sop it all up. Both the sea scallops and tuna were cooked to perfection. However, i rated the value as good only because the scallop and tuna dishes were topas sized and that didn't match the price. Tylor, our server, was great and very patient with the many questions my friends asked. The chef was accommodating to change up the dishes a little bit for the picky eaters.
Horrible service , serve the side dishes 15 minutes before they bought the main courses

this is now just another american cafe that you won’t remember and has nothing to talk to your friends about it.  marriott, please bring back the famous Phoenician resort sunday brunch buffet and the ice sculptures.

We absolutely loved this restaurant. It was four of us (my 86-year-old mother and my two sister in laws and myself). We thought the restaurant was beautiful and that the food was divine. We were raving the entire time about the great cuisine and the beautiful aesthetic, down to the serving utensils. My mom had stayed at the Phoenician with my dad 25 years ago and was so glad to be back. I would highly recommend this restaurant and particularly sitting outside overlooking the pool on a Sunday afternoon.
My son loved the food.  I thought the rib eye had far too much gristle.  The bread was fabulous as was the presentation thereof.  Salmon was tasty and well - presented.

Our Salmon Bowl was absolutely delicious! We would come back

just for that!  The restaurant was not busy at lunch time. Service was helpful

and attentive.
Food was amazing but service needs more work. If they can figure out the two, it will be a great place!
The food was delicious! Service could be improved a little .. oh and also the cocktails could be a little better .
Excellent service and food. Also enjoyed the gentleman with the hawk.
Excellent food & service! Beautiful view on the patio. Can’t wait to go again!
The food was great as well as the service. It is definitely a unique dining experience!
Exceptionally slow service! Our noon brunch concluded at 2:30pm, though our food was timely. No refills of tea or water without flagging down an employee (never our waiter?) or serving ourselves.

The way that they serve the food was disappointing. The waitress made every effort to explain it to our party, but we still didn’t realize that when we ordered lots of vegetables to go with her entrées that didn’t come with anything else on the plate, that they would be served whenever they were ready. So what we ended up with was lots of cauliflower and so on well before our entrées came. It was not a very good experience from that standpoint. Also, the portion were small, the prices were high, and the food itself was fairly mediocre. I will not go back.
Never disappoints. Amazing food and atmosphere.

Very disappointed. Food was over seasoned, and the service was terrible. Two and a half hours to eat dinner?Had high hopes since this is the new and improved premier restaurant for the Phoenician. Bread and soup were the two best things on the menu. Also had an excellent bartender who knows his stuff! Won't be back. If going to Phoenician stick with their steakhouse. Ate there last month and it was totally awesome!
Amazing food and service and it’s gorgeous

Loved, loved, loved this place. Our wait staff (Nicole and Jaquelyn) were over the top. Their enthusiasm for this restaurant was contagious and rightly so! Their help in suggesting what and how much to order was spot on. Th food was fantastic!  Can’t wait to go back during next years visit!

Starting with the positive, great service from the hostess to the waitress. Ambiance was good outside on the patio but a little bright with all the string lights. Food left much to be desired, especially for the price. I would describe most of the dishes we tried as ‘meh’.
Orders took forever, Orders got mixed up, Food was cold and not tasty
Great server! Fun place!
Great food from a unique menu! The atmosphere is perfect and looks right over the beautiful pool.
Both bar and restaurant service extremely slow.

We had an excellent dining experience. We ordered the pheasant which was fabulous. The buttermilk buns are a must. Service although attentive was a little slow. This did not detract from the overall experience.
Great. Would go back

I was really excited to eat here!  Every dish they brought out was either not good or average at best.  The salter Brest was great, the beets were ok, the steaks were just ok, go to a steak house if you want steaks at this price. Very fatty. The salad with peasant had bones in it.  The desert was nothing great. We liked the donuts.  Coffee cold.  Drinks were good.  They need a new chef or new cook.  I think it could be amazing place if they keep it simple with maybe Mexican food. Trying too hard and missing what good be great. When a meal is this expensive I expect great. Not going back!

Four friends gathering to enjoy the beautiful weather on the patio and the excellent cuisine at M&C.  Rachael, our server, was the best--patient, knowledgeable, and good humor.
The Harris Hawk, Flex, that pulled "scarecrow" duty with his trainer (grackles come looking for a leftover or two) was beautiful and such a plus---ecologically friendly and he definitely struck fear in the offending critters.
We enjoyed a variety of salads and flat breads, all colorful and spotlighting local products.  The lemon tart (which we split) was a perfect finish to our lunch.

This is a must!  Culinary artistry in unique and flavourful combinations that delight the senses!  Beautiful presentation!  All the wait staff were knowledgeable, attentive and charming.  Service was impeccable and non-intrusive.  We had the kale, smoked blueberry salad with rogue river bleu cheese—was divine for three—had the pheasant, lamb tacos and salmon, all superb!  The barbecued beet salad with smoked onion yogurt—where can you get a dish like that?!!  To die for!  The flatbread  was delicious—Camembert with acorn squash, apple—again for 3–Perfect.  We had Kir and Negroni aperitifs that we’re splendid!  We will return!  We met Chef Tandy Peterson—a Chef to watch!  A star!!!
wonderful lunch & breakfast menu. good service & great outdoor seating. loved the salad choices. will be back.
It was lovely.  Enjoyed food, a little different than the usual.  Sat outside, nice setting.  Good service.
No complaints. Our waiter David was engaging, knowledgable and friendly. Food was fantastic and plentiful. Dessert was awesome!
We had a fabulous time and it was just a great unique dining experience with exceptional food.

WOW!!  Great to have a fabulous restaurant at a hotel.  Nichole was a great server.
Portions were larger than we expected.  This will be our go to place for pre-downtown Phoenix events.
Beautiful yet casual remodel.   
Can't wait to go back with a bunch of friends.
Everything thing was incredible and very full of flavor. I recommend the monkey bread and mushroom flatbread. Great 1st experience and will definitely return.

Felt extremely out of place, requested a booth when making the reservation and were seated at a table with two tables on either side of us that were very very loud. Personally don’t understand why restaurants even have that type of seating where you share a booth with a table right next to you...: food was good but very expensive and the service was less than. My husbands steak had to be sent back for being rare once his meal arrive I had already finished my meal. When we asked for his left overs to bagged up they “ lost” his steak. They only comped is dessert and our waiter barely checked in on us. Will not be returning.
Valentine’s Day was extra special! 💕

Food was really good. Service seemed to be non existent. Took 20 min to receive our drinks. Waitress didn’t even notice that our water glasses were empty and had to request more water. Still in disbelief that a cup of plain coffee was more than Starbucks at $6.
Food was great.  Huge patio with plenty of outdoor dining.  Had to pay to park in resort garage.  Annoying.   For what it is (a resort restaraunt) it was top notch.
Superb! We will definitely be back!
No more brunch buffet! We were so disappointed.
Really amazing food with a beautiful view. Casual dining at its best!  Don’t miss the whole striped bass.

Food was interesting and very tasty. Even though we had a reservation we had to wait for a table. We had to wait a long time for a server to even come to our table once we were seated. Both our server and the bartender seemed overwhelmed. Place seemed way understaffed.

We enjoyed the food and ambiance, while the waiters were very personable and other staff open, I felt like our table and the explanation of our courses were an after thought for our designated waitress.
Food was outstanding. The bartender went out of his way to make me a special drink and it was amazing. Service was perfect. Can’t wait to go back
Worst service ever. We never got to order so can’t really rate the food.

I would rate M&C as one of the best meals I not only ate on my visit to Phoenix, but maybe ever!

Although there are a fair amount of highly rated options in town, I strongly recommend venturing to this spot (in a resort, no less). The chef is doing amazing things with flavor combinations and the service was both helpful and entertaining as they helped us pair wine with our meals and make general suggestions.

The menu is tailored toward the adventurous diner - wild game and local vegetables abound. I will be recommending M&C to everyone I know who will be visiting Phoenix!

the location is beautiful. But the service leaves allot to be desired. its unfortunate bc the place is really pretty all it takes is a nice greeting and friendly service. I think it was just our server.. she was extremely rude to our table (of women) but we witnessed her being extremely fun and helpful to the table of men next to ours.. (they even commented to us about it) ..very strange. We constantly had to reorder our drinks twice.. waited long amounts of time for them to finally arrive .. food as well.. the restaurant was not busy at all.. we could not find her at all when we were ready for the check. we will not go back.. too bad

This was one of the finest meals I have had in Phoenix. Every server, down to the busboys greeted us and referred to us by name. The food was outstanding. We had the crab dip, then pheasant and black cod accompan by carmelized cauliflower which was exceptional. The chef is meticulous and creative. We will definitely return and recommend it to all. By the way, valet parking is gratis.
We had a great evening with neighbors and enjoyed great service and a excellent meal while sitting outside with a beautiful view.

Very nice hotel casual dining room. Salmon entree was very good, steak  and pheasant were ok. 
We had 2 starters-the meatballs and flatbread were very good, although the plates were hot, the food was really not. The kitchen isn't that far for food to be served cool. Lemon meringue pie was great, unique.
Not sure I will go back, maybe for happy hour.

Positives-service was very attentive and helpful with the menu.
Wait staff became increasingly unattentive as the night went on. Table was not bussed and we had to find our own cutlery. Very poor which is too bad. We were excited about the remodel!
Interesting experience, read about it in magazine, waiter was adequate. Slow at serving drinks and food came out in weird intervals. Was expecting a lot more after the write up in the magazine

They need to add a few more lunch items if you r staying open til 2
Tell open take your last opening is at 2  as they took a booking for 230 on their site
Scallops were cold and the appetizer was served after we received our entrees.  Salmon was good, as were the potatoes.  Drinks were very good.
SERVICE AND FOOD WERE EXCELLENT,BUT MENU IS SOMEWHAT LIMITED OF STANDARDS.

The menu was interesting and eclectic.  Servings are family style which was nice because everyone was able to taste several things.  We sat outside and the view was amazing.  However, we did have 2 issues: the first  was with the brisket soup.  It was "toxic" with salt.  I actually am teased by our friends because of how much I love salt and this soup was way too salty for even me.  After complaining a few times, the server just agreed that it was salty and made no offer to bring something else or take it off the check.  Which brings me to my second point.  The server was a nice kid but his serving skills were lacking.  His timing was off - he interrupted us during a toast as well as several other times when we were clearly having an engaged conversation.  The restaurant was not busy and there should have been no reason to just abruptly butt into our conversation.  He needs better training and coaching.  Our bill was bout $50 per person which included one drink.  Not bad for the Phoenician.  In all, I'd go back again but I would avoid the soup at all costs.
We had a wonderful dining experience here. Our server, Samantha was solitious, knowledgeable, and checked back frequently to ensure that we were happy. Enjoyed it very much
Nick, our server, made the experience. Highly recommend. Was a wonderful date night spot
One of the worse meals I be had in a long time they need to start over and visit some of the other restaurants in valley

Our lunch group chose Mowry and Cotton as it was new and we having been together for several years, we try to find a holiday venue that is special. As this was new to our Phoenix restaurant scene and part of the fabulous Phoenician resort, we could not have made a better choice.  Our wait staff was attentive to all our needs, the dining room is open and yet you  feel you have your own space. Chairs were extremely comfortable and our waiter and his assistant watched for all of our needs.The menu was varied and each of us enjoyed our selection.  While it is a new venue, they were most attentive  in seeing that our holiday luncheon was special for us.
We have date night weekly and love trying new places.  This truly was a hidden gem and will be back! Great food! Great Service!!
Delicious Salmon bowl.  Great service.

Jack was an excellent waiter 
Food was terrific 
Great looking space

Celebrated my Aunt’s 90th Birthday there.   We shared several items and particularly noteworthy were the veal meatballs, lamb tacos and the roasted cauliflower.  Nick our waiter was fantastic.  Can’t wait to return.

Yet another transformation of a traditionaL fine dining room into a communal, plate-sharing ,
bar-like, noisy pub. The evening started with a waiter who was so annoying that he could ruin anyone's meal. His use of wait-speak and mangling of the english langauge was epic. We ordered a kale salad which was awful. The promised ingredients were barely present and the dressing was a tasteless milky water. There were no serving utensils despite the fact that it was supposed to be a shared plate. As we were half way through the salad, the waiter brought the black cod mains we had ordered. The waiter could not understand why that there might be a problem. The fish was mediocre. The apple crumble for dessert was sweet glop with tasteless ice cream. Tragic evening.
My husband and I and our two kids had a wonderful dinner at this restaurant. Food is interesting, and delicious. Service is excellent. We will be back.

Excited to see the redo, but sorry to report decor not to our liking but then we liked it before. Sorry to react  to menu in similar fashion. Fallback hamburger ordered but hard to enjoy an overcooked $21 burger with replacement for tepid fries not arriving until burger was consumed. Waiter had indicated choice of salad or fries but bill turned out to be plus $4 for fries.
Thanksgiving dinner menu, kitchen ran extremely behind. 40 minutes from salads to dinner service. Not worth the price charged with the significant delay.

We were told that this is a new/reconfigured restaurant within the beautiful Phoenician resort.  The staff is welcoming and we only waited for a couple of minutes to be seated after arriving at the hostess stand.  Our waiter, Luis, was knowledgeable and went out of his way to accommodate our party of five and their desires.  We were there on Thanksgiving and diners had the choice to enjoy the “Thanksgiving Feast” which was truly bounteous!  It started with buttermilk buns with two types of butter: duck fat and citrus.  It also came with some petite olives and pickles and was DELICIOUS!  The next course was  two salads - a wild rice and apple salad and a kale and butternut salad - both very good.  Following the salad was guanciale wrapped dates and carmelized cauliflower - creative and tasty.   On to the entrees...Herb roasted turkey, whole roasted striped bass, wild mushroom stuffing (delicious) and a roasted squash dish that our vegetarian daughter-in-law LOVED. 
The finale to a tremendous quantity of culinary effort was an array of small pumpkin and pecan tarts.  At $58 per person, it was a lot of quality cuisine.  However, after the first two courses, the food arrived VERY slowly and not all of the ‘hot’ items were hot.  We were there over three hours and about half of the time was spent waiting.  Our waiter really seemed like he was hustling so the holdup might have been in the kitchen.  
All in all, we will give them a second chance.

This was for an early brunch for 4 on Thanksgiving. Food was very very good but we waited while they seated walkins for breakfast way past our reservation time and then the food was very slow coming from kitchen. We had a 10:30 reservation and were still waiting for any food at 1140. The  wait staff was pleasant and apologetic and the manager comped our meal so they did try to make up for it. But when we were first seated a table of 5 near us burst into cheers and applause saying “finally our food” so I don’t think it was just us.   This could be because it was Thanksgiving and the food was great so if I had plenty of time I might try it again.

This restaurant is part of the wonderful Phoenician resort.  Overlooking the pool complex it offers very interesting and innovative small plate and shared fare, with great twists on foods, lots of unusual presentations, superb combination of tastes and ingredients.  Our wait for drinks was a bit slow, but after that things moved right along.  the buttermilk biscuits are great, chopped salad with pheasant very good, we enjoyed the carpaccio and lamb tacos.  If there is a criticism, small, that it is, is that they overuse the pickled vegetables with too many dishes.  Of course we didn’t have to eat them too, which we did, but with every dish it was somewhat surprising.  Well made drinks, wines are limited but of high quality.
Another delicious dinner. The vegetables dishes are a must try: I recommend the brussel sprouts .

Perfect dining experience with great food and service by David along with his team. The menu is well-balanced and vegetarian friendly with several delicious options like smoked beets! We ordered and would suggest trying the mushroom flatbread , scallops, butternut salad and buttermilk bread. 

We sat outdoor on the patio and enjoyed the beautiful November evening weather, albeit the lights were a little bright.  Dinner was for business but I will be back with the family and friends- I would  definitely recommend Mowry Cotton for other occasions, especially larger group since their concept is communal dining.

We celebrated my birthday at Mowry and Cotton with my family including a couple of kiddos. The staff were all very attentive, patient, and kind to our group. My husband even arranged a cake for my bday and the restaurant was accommodating. Sarah was incredible and the other servers were so friendly too. She answered all our questions and was great. The food was delicious and I’ve already recommended it to others!
Great food served for the who;e table . Lots of inventive items . Service was fantastic the staff has been well trained. Looking forward to going back soon
Great food.  Great service.  Wonderful atmosphere.  Not too loud and definitely not boring!
Really a wonderful dining experience.  Our server was passionate and well informed, the food was exceptional and the chef even came out to chat with us.

Originally sat outside which was a mistake. Looks like a picnic area. Very bright with uncomfortable chairs. Large group sat next to us with several very unhappy children. Seating inside the restaurant was much better. We are glad we stayed as the food was very good and server was excellent.
Amazing!!!!  We will be back for sure!!  We loved it!
The Bison Carpaccio and the Pheasant were big hits as was the Tuna...our server Nick was spot on with recommends and very helpful and enthusiastic about the menu.  A fun time - we will be back!

We celebrated my birthday dinner and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. Our server was passionate, fun and very informed about the food and their creative cocktails and we had so much fun talking about the menu.
We ended up choosing the semolina bread with crab dip (amazing!!!), roasted squash (served with whipped feta - OMG!), smoked spare ribs with a snap pea slaw and the whole striped bass to share. My son ordered the kids chicken and waffles which was super creatively served with waffle bites in a waffle cone, along with fries. The food came out perfectly, super flavorful, creative and we just loved everything we had. We will definitely be back to try other delicious menu choices. And soon!
Really delicious. Went the first night they were open for sinner. Everything is so fresh and delicious.

We used to enjoy Sunday&Holiday brunch at the Phoenician for years. Always loved it.  Extremely disappointed about the change from what it used to be (a great Sunday brunch at The Il Terrazzo) and this new place Mowry&Cotton. Very different atmosphere (too casual), style&design since remodeling (country style at the Phoenician???). We didn't enjoy the food, drinks, dessert.  Expensive though. My husbands steak had to be sent back twice for being awfully rare. We had a party of seven and no one liked that weird food on menu. We regret our decision to bring family to this place in hopes that new restaurant can't be bad at the Phoenician. Wrong! Will be never again going to this place.
